Key.description: Regular character key for keyboard layouts.

InstanceRepeater.description: Instantiates components based on an instance table.

properties.instancingTable: This property specifies the instance table used by the repeater.

XrHapticFeedback.description: Controls haptic feedback for an XR controller.

properties.condition: The condition for triggering this haptic feedback.
properties.controller: The Controller that this haptic feedback will apply to.
properties.hapticEffect: This property describes the effect that is applied to the controller when the haptic feedback is triggered.

PathElement.description: PathElement is the base path type.

XdgPopup.description: XdgPopup represents the popup specific parts of and xdg surface.

properties.parentXdgSurface: This property holds the XdgSurface associated with the parent of this XdgPopup.
properties.xdgSurface: This property holds the XdgSurface associated with this XdgPopup.
properties.resizeConstraints: This property holds the orientations in which the child should resize to fit within the screen.
properties.configuredGeometry: The window geometry the popup received in the configure event. Relative to the upper left corner of the parent surface.
properties.gravityEdges: Specifies in what direction the surface should be positioned, relative to the anchor point.
properties.slideConstraints: This property holds the orientations in which the child should slide to fit within the screen.
properties.anchorRect: The anchor rectangle relative to the parent window geometry that the child surface should be placed relative to.
properties.unconstrainedPosition: The position of the surface relative to the parent window geometry if the surface is not constrained. I.e. when not moved to fit inside the screen or similar.
properties.positionerSize: The size requested for the window geometry by the positioner object.
properties.anchorEdges: This property holds the set of edges on the anchor rect that the child surface should be placed relative to. If no edges are specified in a direction, the anchor point should be centered between the edges.
properties.offset: The position relative to the position of the anchor on the anchor rectangle and the anchor on the surface.
properties.flipConstraints: This property holds the orientations in which the child should flip to fit within the screen.

Obsolete Members for Text.description: The following members of QML type Text are deprecated. They are provided to keep old source code working. We strongly advise against using them in new code.

ControlStyleProperties.description: Defines the stylable properties for a control.

properties.handle: Grouped property for styling the handle of a control.
properties.topPadding: The top padding of the control. If not set, falls back to padding.
properties.bottomPadding: The bottom padding of the control. If not set, falls back to padding.
properties.text: Grouped property for styling the text label of a control.
properties.transition: A Transition used to animate style properties when the control enters a new state, such as hovered or pressed. If set to null (the default), property changes are applied immediately without animation.
properties.leftPadding: The left padding of the control. If not set, falls back to padding.
properties.indicator: Grouped property for styling the indicator of a control. For a checkBox, the indicator is the frame, and its foreground is the check mark. For a slider, the indicator is the groove, and the foreground is the fill.
properties.padding: The uniform spacing between the control's content area and the bounds of the control. Setting this provides a default value for leftPadding, rightPadding, topPadding, and bottomPadding. Each side can be overridden individually.
properties.rightPadding: The right padding of the control. If not set, falls back to padding.
properties.background: Grouped property for styling the background of a control.
properties.spacing: The spacing between visual elements inside the control, for example between an indicator and a label.

Camera.description: Defines a view point through which the scene will be rendered.

properties.right: Holds the current right of the camera.
properties.exposure: Holds the current exposure of the camera.
properties.top: Holds the current top of the camera.
properties.viewCenter: Holds the current view center of the camera in coordinates relative to the parent entity.
properties.transform: Holds the Transform component of the camera.
properties.viewVector: Holds the camera's view vector in coordinates relative to the parent entity.
properties.projectionMatrix: Holds the current projection matrix of the camera.
properties.lens: Holds the CameraLens component of the camera.
properties.fieldOfView: Holds the current vertical field of view of the camera in degrees.
properties.left: Holds the current left of the camera.
properties.upVector: Holds the current up vector of the camera in coordinates relative to the parent entity.
properties.farPlane: Holds the current camera far plane of the camera. Objects that are farther from the camera than the farPlane will not be rendered.
properties.nearPlane: Holds the current camera near plane of the camera. Objects that are closer to the camera than the nearPlane will not be rendered.
properties.bottom: Holds the current bottom of the camera.
properties.position: Holds the current position of the camera in coordinates relative to the parent entity.
properties.projectionType: Holds the type of the camera projection. The default value is CameraLens.PerspectiveProjection.
properties.aspectRatio: Holds the current aspect ratio of the camera.

Canvas2D.description: Provides a 2D canvas item enabling drawing via JavaScript.

properties.contextType: The type of drawing context to use.
properties.available: Indicates when Canvas is able to provide a drawing context to operate on.

ScissorTest.description: The ScissorTest type discards fragments that fall outside of a certain rectangular portion of the screen.

properties.left: Holds the left coordinate of the scissor box.
properties.height: Holds the height of the scissor box.
properties.bottom: Holds the bottom coordinate of the scissor box.
properties.width: Holds the width of the scissor box.

Effect.description: The base class for effects in a Qt 3D scene.

properties.parameters: Holds the list of parameters used by this effect. A parameter is used to set a corresponding uniform value in the shader used by this effect.
properties.techniques: Holds the list of techniques used by this effect.

renderTargetBlend QML Value Type.description: Defines blending parameters for a single color attachment of a render pass.

properties.colorWrite: A bitmask that controls which color channels are written to the color attachment. Multiple values can be combined with the | operator. The default value is R | G | B | A.
properties.srcAlpha: Sets the source alpha blend factor. This value scales the alpha component of the fragment shader output before the blend operation. The default value is One. See srcColor for the list of available values.
properties.dstColor: Sets the destination color blend factor. This value scales the RGB components of the current value in the color attachment before the blend operation. The default value is OneMinusSrcAlpha. See srcColor for the list of available values.
properties.opAlpha: Sets the arithmetic operation used to combine the scaled source and destination alpha components. The default value is Add. See opColor for the list of available values.
properties.dstAlpha: Sets the destination alpha blend factor. This value scales the alpha component of the current value in the color attachment before the blend operation. The default value is OneMinusSrcAlpha. See srcColor for the list of available values.
properties.srcColor: Sets the source color blend factor. This value scales the RGB components of the fragment shader output before the blend operation. The default value is One.
properties.opColor: Sets the arithmetic operation used to combine the scaled source and destination color components. The default value is Add.
properties.blendEnabled: If set to true, enables blending for the color attachment. If set to false, disables blending and the output color is written directly to the attachment. The default value is false.

PathQuad.description: Defines a quadratic Bezier curve with a control point.

XrSpatialAnchor.description: Tracks a specific location or object in real space.

properties.identifier: A unique identifier for this spatial anchor.
properties.classificationString: The classification type of the spatial anchor as a string.
properties.Classification: The classification of the spatial anchor.
properties.extent3D: The 3D extent of the spatial anchor.
properties.extent2D: The 2D extent of the spatial anchor.
properties.offset2D: The 2D offset of the spatial anchor.
properties.has2DBounds: Indicates whether the spatial anchor has 2D bounds.
properties.classification: The classification type of the spatial anchor.
properties.has3DBounds: Indicates whether the spatial anchor has 3D bounds.
properties.offset3D: The 3D offset of the spatial anchor.
properties.rotation: The orientation of the spatial anchor.
properties.position: The position of the spatial anchor.

Texture2D.description: An AbstractTexture with a Target2D target format.

GridLayout.description: Provides a way of dynamically arranging items in a grid.

properties.uniformCellWidths: If this property is set to true, the layout will force all cells to have a uniform width. The layout aims to respect Layout.minimumWidth, Layout.preferredWidth and Layout.maximumWidth in this mode but might make compromisses to fullfill the requirements of all items.
properties.flow: This property holds the flow direction of items that does not have an explicit cell position set. It is used together with the columns or rows property, where they specify when flow is reset to the next row or column respectively.
properties.layoutDirection: This property holds the layout direction of the grid layout - it controls whether items are laid out from left to right or right to left. If Qt.RightToLeft is specified, left-aligned items will be right-aligned and right-aligned items will be left-aligned.
properties.uniformCellHeights: If this property is set to true, the layout will force all cells to have an uniform Height. The layout aims to respect Layout.minimumHeight, Layout.preferredHeight and Layout.maximumHeight in this mode but might make compromisses to fullfill the requirements of all items.
properties.columns: This property holds the column limit for items positioned if flow is GridLayout.LeftToRight. The default value is that there is no limit.
properties.rowSpacing: This property holds the spacing between each row. The default value is 5.
properties.rows: This property holds the row limit for items positioned if flow is GridLayout.TopToBottom. The default value is that there is no limit.
properties.columnSpacing: This property holds the spacing between each column. The default value is 5.

ParticleSystem.description: A system which includes particle painter, emitter, and affector types.

properties.particleStates: You can define a sub-set of particle groups in this property in order to provide them with stochastic state transitions.
properties.running: If running is set to false, the particle system will stop the simulation. All particles will be destroyed when the system is set to running again.
properties.empty: empty is set to true when there are no live particles left in the system.
properties.paused: If paused is set to true, the particle system will not advance the simulation. When paused is set to false again, the simulation will resume from the same point it was paused.

QAbstractTransition.description: The QAbstractTransition type is the base type of transitions between QAbstractState objects.

properties.sourceState: The source state (parent) of this transition.
properties.targetStates: The target states of this transition.
properties.targetState: The target state of this transition.

LayoutMirroring (Uncreatable).description: Property used to mirror layout behavior.

properties.enabled: This property holds whether the item's layout is mirrored horizontally. Setting this to true horizontally reverses anchor settings such that left anchors become right, and right anchors become left. For positioner types (such as Row and Grid) and view types (such as GridView and ListView) this also mirrors the horizontal layout direction of the item.
properties.childrenInherit: This property holds whether the LayoutMirroring.enabled value for this item is inherited by its children.

PrincipledMaterial.description: Lets you define a material for 3D items using the metal/roughness workflow.

properties.fresnelScaleBiasEnabled: By Setting the value to true the material will take Fresnel Scale and Fresnel Bias into account. The default value is false.
properties.clearcoatFresnelScaleBiasEnabled: By Setting the value to true the material will take Clearcoat Fresnel Scale and Clearcoat Fresnel Bias into account. The default value is false.
properties.pointSize: This property determines the size of the points rendered, when the geometry is using a primitive type of points. The default value is 1.0. This property is not relevant when rendering other types of geometry, such as, triangle meshes.
properties.heightChannel: This property defines the texture channel used to read the height value from heightMap. The default value is Material.R.
properties.specularReflectionMap: This property sets a Texture used for specular highlights on the material.
properties.clearcoatRoughnessAmount: This property defines the roughness of the clearcoat layer. The default value is 0.0
properties.maxHeightMapSamples: This property defines the maximum number of samples used for performing Parallex Occlusion Mapping using the heightMap. The maxHeightMapSamples value is the number of samples of the heightMap are used when looking parallel to a surface. The default value is 32.
properties.thicknessMap: This property defines a texture used to define the thickness of a material volume. The value of thicknessFactor will be multiplied by the value read from this texture.
properties.clearcoatRoughnessChannel: This property defines the texture channel used to read the clearcoat roughness amount from clearcoatRoughnessMap. The default value is Material.G.
properties.occlusionAmount: This property contains the factor used to modify the values from the occlusionMap texture. The value should be between 0.0 to 1.0. The default is 1.0
properties.vertexColorRedMask: This property defines the vertex color red channel used as the specifies mask. The value is a bit-wise combination of flags. The default value is PrincipledMaterial.NoMask.
properties.emissiveFactor: This property determines the color of self-illumination for this material. If an emissive map is set, the x, y, and z components are used as factors (multipliers) for the R, G and B channels of the texture, respectively. The default value is (0, 0, 0) and it means no emissive contribution at all.
properties.attenuationColor: This property defines the color that white lights turns into due to absorption when reaching the attenuation distance. The default value is Qt.White
properties.metalness: The metalness property defines the metalness of the the material. The value is normalized, where 0.0 means the material is a dielectric (non-metallic) material and a value of 1.0 means the material is a metal.
properties.baseColor: This property sets the base color for the material. Depending on the type of material specified (metal or dielectric) the diffuse and specular channels will be set appropriately. For example, a dielectric material will have a diffuse color equal to the base color, while it's specular color, depending on the specular amount, will have a bright specular color. For metals the diffuse and specular channels will be mixed from the base color and have a dark diffuse channel and a specular channel close to the base color.
properties.thicknessChannel: This property defines the texture channel used to read the thickness amount from transmissionMap. The default value is Material.G.
properties.opacityMap: This property defines a Texture used to control the opacity differently for different parts of the material.
properties.vertexColorsMaskEnabled: When this property is enabled, the material will use vertex colors from the mesh as mask of various properties e.g RoughnessAmount, SpecularAmount, ... . The default value is false.
properties.fresnelBias: This property push forward head-on reflections (looking directly at the surface) while maintaining reflections seen at grazing angles. In order to affect changes to the material you have to enable fresnelScaleBiasEnabled. The default value is 0.0.
properties.baseColorChannel: This property defines the texture channel used to read the baseColor value from baseColorMap. In order to use a single texture channel as color you have to enable the baseColorSingleChannelEnabled The default value is Material.R.
properties.lighting: This property defines which lighting method is used when generating this material.
properties.roughnessChannel: This property defines the texture channel used to read the roughness value from roughnessMap. The default value is Material.G.
properties.heightAmount: This property contains the factor used to modify the values from the heightMap texture. The value should be between 0.0 to 1.0. The default value is 0.0 which means that height displacement will be disabled, even if a height map set.
properties.vertexColorsEnabled: When this property is enabled, the material will use vertex colors from the mesh. These will be multiplied by any other colors specified for the material. The default value is true.
properties.alphaMode: This property specifies how the alpha color value from baseColor and the alpha channel of a base color map are used.
properties.emissiveSingleChannelEnabled: When this property is enabled, the material will use the single value of the emissiveChannel from the emissiveMap as RGB value. The default value is false.
properties.minHeightMapSamples: This property defines the minimum number of samples used for performing Parallex Occlusion Mapping using the heightMap. The minHeightMapSamples value is the number of samples of the heightMap are used when looking directly at a surface (when the camera view is perpendicular to the fragment). The default value is 8.
properties.clearcoatFresnelPower: This property decreases head-on reflections (looking directly at the surface) while maintaining reflections seen at grazing angles. The default value is 5.0.
properties.opacity: This property drops the opacity of just this material, separate from the model.
properties.normalStrength: This property controls the amount of simulated displacement for the normalMap.
properties.clearcoatNormalStrength: This property controls the amount of simulated displacement for the clearcoatNormalMap.
properties.fresnelPower: This property decreases head-on reflections (looking directly at the surface) while maintaining reflections seen at grazing angles. The default value is 5.0.
properties.clearcoatFresnelBias: This property push forward head-on reflections (looking directly at the surface) while maintaining reflections seen at grazing angles. In order to affect changes to the material you have to enable clearcoatFresnelScaleBiasEnabled. The default value is 0.0.
properties.heightMap: This property defines a texture used to determine the height the texture will be displaced when rendered through the use of Parallax Mapping. Values are expected to be linear from 0.0 to 1.0, where 0.0 means no displacement and 1.0 means means maximum displacement.
properties.indexOfRefraction: This property defines the index of refraction of the material. The default value of 1.5 will be the ideal value for materials like plastics or glass but other materials like water, asphalt, sapphire, or diamond would require and adjusted value to look more realistic. For realistic materials the indexOfRefraction should usually be between 1.0 and 3.0
properties.emissiveChannel: This property defines the texture channel used to read the emissive value from emissiveMap. In order to use a single texture channel as color you have to enable the emissiveSingleChannelEnabled The default value is Material.R.
properties.specularMap: The property defines a RGB Texture to modulate the amount and the color of specularity across the surface of the material. These values are multiplied by the specularAmount.
properties.baseColorSingleChannelEnabled: When this property is enabled, the material will use the single value of the baseColorChannel from the baseColorMap as RGB value and use 1.0 as alpha value. The default value is false.
properties.vertexColorAlphaMask: This property defines the vertex color alpha channel used as the specifies mask. The value is a bit-wise combination of flags. The default value is PrincipledMaterial.NoMask.
properties.clearcoatFresnelScale: This property scale head-on reflections (looking directly at the surface) while maintaining reflections seen at grazing angles. In order to affect changes to the material you have to enable clearcoatFresnelScaleBiasEnabled. The default value is 1.0.
properties.lineWidth: This property determines the width of the lines rendered, when the geometry is using a primitive type of lines or line strips. The default value is 1.0. This property is not relevant when rendering other types of geometry, such as, triangle meshes.
properties.metalnessMap: This property sets a Texture to be used to set the metalness amount for the different parts of the material.
properties.occlusionMap: This property defines a texture used to determine how much light the different areas of the material should receive. Values are expected to be linear from 0.0 to 1.0, where 0.0 means no lighting and 1.0 means the effect of the lighting is left unchanged.
properties.roughness: This property controls the size of the specular highlight generated from lights, and the clarity of reflections in general. Larger values increase the roughness, softening specular highlights and blurring reflections. The range is [0.0, 1.0]. The default value is 0.
properties.specularAmount: This property controls the strength of specularity (highlights and reflections).
properties.alphaCutoff: The alphaCutoff property can be used to specify the cutoff value when using the Mask alphaMode. Fragments where the alpha value falls below the threshold will be rendered fully transparent (0.0 for all color channels). When the alpha value is equal or greater than the cutoff value, the color will not be affected in any way.
properties.emissiveMap: This property sets a RGB Texture to be used to specify the intensity of the emissive color.
properties.transmissionFactor: This property defines the percentage of light that is transmitted through the material's surface. The default value is 0.0
properties.vertexColorBlueMask: This property defines the vertex color blue channel used as the specifies mask. The value is a bit-wise combination of flags. The default value is PrincipledMaterial.NoMask.
properties.vertexColorGreenMask: This property defines the vertex color green channel used as the specifies mask. The value is a bit-wise combination of flags. The default value is PrincipledMaterial.NoMask.
properties.clearcoatAmount: This property defines the intensity of the clearcoat layer.
properties.clearcoatChannel: This property defines the texture channel used to read the clearcoat amount value from clearcoatMap. The default value is Material.R.
properties.opacityChannel: This property defines the texture channel used to read the opacity value from opacityMap. The default value is Material.A.
properties.specularSingleChannelEnabled: When this property is enabled, the material will use the single value of the specularChannel from the specularMap as RGB value. The default value is false.
properties.occlusionChannel: This property defines the texture channel used to read the occlusion value from occlusionMap. The default value is Material.R.
properties.thicknessFactor: This property defines the thickness of the volume beneath the surface. Unlike many other properties of PrincipledMaterial, the value in defined in thicknessFactor is a value from 0.0 to +infinity for thickness in the models coordinate space. A value of 0.0 means that the material is thin-walled. The default value is 0.0
properties.attenuationDistance: This property defines the Density of the medium given as the average distance that light travels in the medium before interacting with a particle. The value is given in world space. The default value is +infinity.
properties.clearcoatRoughnessMap: This property defines a texture used to determine the roughness of the clearcoat layer. The value ofclearcoatRoughnessAmount will be multiplied by the value read from this texture.
properties.baseColorMap: This property defines the texture used to set the base color of the material.
properties.specularChannel: This property defines the texture channel used to read the specular color value from specularMap. In order to use a single texture channel as color you have to enable the specularSingleChannelEnabled The default value is Material.R.
properties.transmissionMap: This property defines a texture used to determine percentage of light that is transmitted through the surface.. The value of transmissionFactor will be multiplied by the value read from this texture.
properties.roughnessMap: This property defines a Texture to control the specular roughness of the material.
properties.blendMode: This property determines how the colors of the model rendered blends with those behind it.
properties.clearcoatNormalMap: This property defines a texture used to determine the normal mapping applied to the clearcoat layer.
properties.transmissionChannel: This property defines the texture channel used to read the transmission percentage from transmissionMap. The default value is Material.R.
properties.fresnelScale: This property scale head-on reflections (looking directly at the surface) while maintaining reflections seen at grazing angles. In order to affect changes to the material you have to enable fresnelScaleBiasEnabled. The default value is 1.0.
properties.normalMap: This property defines an RGB image used to simulate fine geometry displacement across the surface of the material. The RGB channels indicate XYZ normal deviations.
properties.invertOpacityMapValue: This property inverts the opacity value of the opacityMap. The default value is false.
properties.clearcoatMap: This property defines a texture used to determine the intensity of the clearcoat layer. The value ofclearcoatAmount will be multiplied by the value read from this texture.
properties.specularTint: This property defines how much of the base color contributes to the specular reflections.
properties.metalnessChannel: This property defines the texture channel used to read the metalness value from metalnessMap. The default value is Material.B.

properties.maxDistance: The maximum distance of the joint constraint. The constraint is only enforced when this value is greater than 0.0.
properties.minDistance: The minimum distance of the joint constraint. The constraint is only enforced when this value is greater than 0.0.

FlexboxLayout.description: The FlexboxLayout QML construct provides a flex layout for the quick items.

properties.columnGap: This property holds the amount of space that need to be applied to the FlexboxLayout along the inline axis. Setting this property override the gap value affecting the inline axis.
properties.direction: This property holds the item layout direction within the flex box layout and it defines the main-axis.
properties.alignContent: This property specifies the distribution of the flex lines along the cross-axis of the flex box layout.
properties.rowGap: This property holds the amount of space that need to be applied to the FlexboxLayout along the block axis. Setting this property overrides the gap value affecting the block axis.
properties.wrap: This property specifies that the items within the flex box layout can wrap or not and it happens when the children overflow the size of the flex box layout. If the items are wrapped, it will be placed in multiple lines depending on overflow condition as stated. Each line takes up the maximum size of the item along the cross-axis.
properties.alignItems: This property specifies the alignment of the items within the flex lines of the flex box layout and its aligned along the cross-axis (which is orthogonal to the main-axis, as defined by the property direction). This property can be overridden by the items within the flex box layout through the attached property FlexboxLayout.alignSelf.
properties.justifyContent: This property specifies the distribution of the items along the main-axis of the flex box layout.
properties.FlexboxLayout.alignSelf: This attached property allows to align this item in the flex box layout along the cross-axis and it overrides the parent flex box layout property alignItems.
properties.gap: This property holds the amount of space that need to be applied to the FlexboxLayout both along the inline axis and block axis.

properties.discoveryProfileUri: The URI of the supported discovery profile.
properties.applicationType: The application's type: server, client, both, or discovery server.
properties.applicationUri: The globally unique identifier for this application instance.
properties.productUri: The globally unique identifier for this product.
properties.discoveryUrls: A list of URLs of discovery endpoints.
properties.gatewayServerUri: The URI of the gateway server.

Locale.description: Provides locale specific properties and formatted data.

properties.groupSeparator: Holds the group separator character of this locale.
properties.percent: Holds the percent character of this locale.
properties.weekDays: Holds an array of days that are considered week days according to the current locale, where Sunday is 0 and Saturday is 6.
properties.firstDayOfWeek: Holds the first day of the week according to the current locale.
properties.nativeTerritoryName: Holds a native name of the territory for the locale. For example "España" for Spanish/Spain locale.
properties.amText: The localized name of the "AM" suffix for times specified using the conventions of the 12-hour clock.
properties.name: Holds the language and territory of this locale as a string of the form "language_territory", where language is a lowercase, two-letter ISO 639 language code, and territory is an uppercase, two- or three-letter ISO 3166 territory code.
properties.uiLanguages: Returns an ordered list of locale names for translation purposes in preference order.
properties.nativeLanguageName: Holds a native name of the language for the locale. For example "Schwiizertüütsch" for Swiss-German locale.
properties.negativeSign: Holds the negative sign character of this locale.
properties.exponential: Holds the exponential character of this locale.
properties.textDirection: Holds the text direction of the language:
properties.zeroDigit: Holds Returns the zero digit character of this locale.
properties.measurementSystem: This property defines which units are used for measurement.
properties.decimalPoint: Holds the decimal point character of this locale.
properties.pmText: The localized name of the "PM" suffix for times specified using the conventions of the 12-hour clock.
properties.positiveSign: Holds the positive sign character of this locale.
properties.numberOptions: Holds a set of options for number-to-string and string-to-number conversions.

PolygonOffset.description: The PolygonOffset type sets the scale and steps to calculate depth values for polygon offsets.

properties.depthSteps: Holds the units that create constant depth offsets. Default value is 0.
properties.scaleFactor: Holds the scale factor used to create a variable depth offset for each polygon. Default value is 0.

ContextMenu.description: The ContextMenu attached type provides a way to open a context menu in a platform-appropriate manner.

properties.menu: This property holds the context menu that will be opened. It can be set to any Menu object.

properties.model: This property holds the model providing data for the DelegateModel.
properties.delegateModelAccess: This property determines how delegates can access the model.
properties.items: This property holds default group to which all new items are added.
properties.DelegateModel.model: This attached property holds the data model this delegate instance belongs to.
properties.DelegateModel.inItems: This attached property holds whether the item belongs to the default items DelegateModelGroup.
properties.persistedItems: This property holds delegate model's persisted items group.
properties.DelegateModel.itemsIndex: This attached property holds the index of the item in the default items DelegateModelGroup.
properties.DelegateModel.isUnresolved: This attached property indicates whether the visual item is bound to a data model index. Returns true if the item is not bound to the model, and false if it is.
properties.groups: This property holds a delegate model's group definitions.
properties.filterOnGroup: This property holds name of the group that is used to filter the delegate model.
properties.DelegateModel.groups: This attached property holds the name of DelegateModelGroups the item belongs to.
properties.rootIndex: QAbstractItemModel provides a hierarchical tree of data, whereas QML only operates on list data. rootIndex allows the children of any node in a QAbstractItemModel to be provided by this model.
properties.DelegateModel.inPersistedItems: This attached property holds whether the item belongs to the persistedItems DelegateModelGroup.
properties.delegate: The delegate provides a template defining each item instantiated by a view. The index is exposed as an accessible index property. Properties of the model are also available depending upon the type of Data Model.
properties.DelegateModel.persistedItemsIndex: This attached property holds the index of the item in the persistedItems DelegateModelGroup.
properties.parts: The parts property selects a DelegateModel which creates delegates from the part named. This is used in conjunction with the Package type.

VPieModelMapper.description: Vertical model mapper for pie series.

properties.labelsColumn: The column of the model that is kept in sync with the labels of the pie's slices. The default value is -1 (invalid mapping).
properties.rowCount: The number of rows of the model that are mapped as the data for a pie series. The default value is -1 (number limited by the number of rows in the model).
properties.valuesColumn: The column of the model that is kept in sync with the values of the pie's slices. The default value is -1 (invalid mapping).
properties.model: The QAbstractItemModel based model that is used by the mapper. You need to implement the model and expose it to QML.
properties.firstRow: The row of the model that contains the first slice value. The default value is 0.
properties.series: The pie series that is used by the mapper. If you define the mapper element as a child for a PieSeries, leave this property undefined. All the data in the series is discarded when it is set to the mapper. When new series is specified the old series is disconnected (but it preserves its data).

MouseEvent (Uncreatable).description: Provides information about a mouse event.

properties.wasHeld: This property is true if the mouse button has been held pressed longer than the threshold (800ms).
properties.buttons: This property holds the mouse buttons pressed when the event was generated. For mouse move events, this is all buttons that are pressed down. For mouse press and double click events this includes the button that caused the event. For mouse release events this excludes the button that caused the event.
properties.button: This property holds the button that caused the event. It can be one of:
properties.accepted: Setting accepted to true prevents the mouse event from being propagated to items below this item.
properties.modifiers: This property holds the keyboard modifier flags that existed immediately before the event occurred.
properties.flags: This property holds the flags that provide additional information about the mouse event.

SpotLight.description: Encapsulate a Spot Light object in a Qt 3D scene.

properties.localDirection: Specifies the local direction of the spot light.
properties.cutOffAngle: Specifies the cut off angle of the spot light.

ShapePath.description: Describes a Path and associated properties for stroking and filling.

properties.pathHints: This property describes characteristics of the shape. If set, these hints may allow optimized rendering. By default, no hints are set. It can be a combination of the following values:
properties.strokeGradient: This property defines the stroke gradient. By default no gradient is enabled and the value is null. In this case the stroke will be based strokeColor property.
properties.strokeStyle: This property defines the style of stroking. The default value is ShapePath.SolidLine.
properties.fillColor: This property holds the fill color.
properties.strokeColor: This property holds the stroking color.

properties.fillItem: This property defines another Qt Quick Item to use as fill by the shape. The item must be texture provider (such as a layered item, a ShaderEffectSource or an Image). If it is not a valid texture provider, this property will be ignored.
properties.fillRule: This property holds the fill rule. The default value is ShapePath.OddEvenFill. For an explanation on fill rules, see QPainterPath::setFillRule().
properties.dashOffset: This property defines the starting point on the dash pattern, measured in units used to specify the dash pattern.
properties.dashPattern: This property defines the dash pattern when strokeStyle is set to ShapePath.DashLine. The pattern must be specified as an even number of positive entries where the entries 1, 3, 5... are the dashes and 2, 4, 6... are the spaces. The pattern is specified in units of the pen's width.
properties.joinStyle: This property defines how joins between two connected lines are drawn. The default value is ShapePath.BevelJoin.
properties.miterLimit: When joinStyle is set to ShapePath.MiterJoin, this property specifies how far the miter join can extend from the join point.
properties.capStyle: This property defines how the end points of lines are drawn. The default value is ShapePath.SquareCap.
properties.fillTransform: This property defines a transform to be applied to the path's fill pattern (fillGradient or fillItem). It has no effect if the fill is a solid color or transparent. By default no fill transform is enabled and the value of this property is the identity matrix.
properties.fillGradient: This property defines the fill gradient. By default no gradient is enabled and the value is null. In this case the fill will either be based on the fillItem property if it is set, and otherwise the fillColor property will be used.
properties.strokeWidth: This property holds the stroke width.

properties.pressedButtons: This property holds the mouse buttons currently pressed.
properties.pressAndHoldInterval: This property overrides the elapsed time in milliseconds before pressAndHold is emitted.
properties.containsPress: This is a convenience property equivalent to pressed && containsMouse, i.e. it holds whether any of the acceptedButtons are currently pressed and the mouse is currently within the MouseArea.
properties.enabled: This property holds whether the item accepts mouse events.
properties.hoverEnabled: This property holds whether hover events are handled.
properties.propagateComposedEvents: This property holds whether composed mouse events will automatically propagate to other MouseAreas that overlap with this MouseArea but are lower in the visual stacking order. By default, this property is false.
properties.preventStealing: This property holds whether the mouse events may be stolen from this MouseArea.

TrailEmitter.description: Emits logical particles from other logical particles.

properties.emitWidth: The width in pixels the emitShape is scaled to. If set to TrailEmitter.ParticleSize, the width will be the current size of the particle being followed.
properties.emitShape: As the area of a TrailEmitter is the area it follows, a separate shape can be provided to be the shape it emits out of. This shape has width and height specified by emitWidth and emitHeight, and is centered on the followed particle's position.
properties.follow: The type of logical particle which this is emitting from.
properties.emitHeight: The height in pixels the emitShape is scaled to. If set to TrailEmitter.ParticleSize, the height will be the current size of the particle being followed.
properties.velocityFromMovement: If this value is non-zero, then any movement of the emitter will provide additional starting velocity to the particles based on the movement. The additional vector will be the same angle as the emitter's movement, with a magnitude that is the magnitude of the emitters movement multiplied by velocityFromMovement.

Obsolete Members for Qt.description: The following members of QML type Qt are deprecated. They are provided to keep old source code working. We strongly advise against using them in new code.

FrustumCamera.description: Defines a PerspectiveCamera with a custom frustum.

properties.top: The top value specifies the top of the near clip plane, relative to the camera's position in local coordinates.
properties.right: The right value specifies the right of the near clip plane, relative to the camera's position in local coordinates.
properties.bottom: The bottom value specifies the bottom of the near clip plane, relative to the camera's position in local coordinates.
properties.left: The left value specifies the left of the near clip plane, relative to the camera's position in local coordinates.

BarCategoryAxis.description: Adds categories to a chart's axes.

properties.max: The maximum value on the axis.
properties.count: The number of categories of an axis.
properties.min: The minimum value on the axis.

TorusGeometry.description: TorusGeometry allows creation of a torus in 3D space.

properties.rings: Holds the number of rings in the torus.
properties.slices: Holds the number of slices in the torus.
properties.texCoordAttribute: Holds the geometry texture coordinate attribute.
properties.radius: Holds the outer radius of the torus.

routeManeuver.description: The routeManeuver type represents the information relevant to the point at which two routeSegments meet.

properties.extendedAttributes: This property holds the extended attributes of the maneuver and is a map. These attributes are plugin specific, and can be empty.
properties.distanceToNextInstruction: This read-only property holds the distance, in meters, between the point at which the associated instruction was issued and the point that the next instruction should be issued.
properties.timeToNextInstruction: This read-only property holds the estimated time, in seconds, that it will take to travel from the point at which the associated instruction was issued to the point at which the next instruction should be issued, in seconds.
properties.valid: This read-only property holds whether this maneuver is valid or not.
properties.waypoint: This property holds the waypoint associated with this maneuver. Not all maneuvers have a waypoint associated with them.
properties.direction: Describes the change in direction associated with the instruction text that is associated with a routeManeuver.
properties.position: This read-only property holds where the instructionText should be displayed.
properties.instructionText: This read-only property holds textual navigation instruction.

IndicatorStyle.description: Defines the style for a control's indicator.

properties.second: Grouped property for styling the second sub-indicator of for example a SpinBox. Unset properties fall back to the indicator itself.
properties.first: Grouped property for styling the first sub-indicator of controls that expose multiple indicators. For SpinBox, this styles the increment button. Unset properties fall back to the indicator itself.
properties.foreground: Grouped property for styling the foreground element of this indicator. For example, checkBox.indicator describes the check box frame, while checkBox.indicator.foreground is the check mark.

Blend.description: Merges two source items by using a blend mode.

properties.mode: This property defines the mode which is used when foregroundSource is blended over source. Values are case insensitive.
properties.source: This property defines the source item that is going to be the base when foregroundSource is blended over it.
properties.foregroundSource: This property defines the item that is going to be blended over the source.
properties.cached: This property allows the effect output pixels to be cached in order to improve the rendering performance.

properties.effect: Specifies the effect to be used with the material.
properties.parameters: Holds the list of parameters used by the material.

properties.isDefault: Is true if this is the default audio device.
properties.description: Holds a human readable name of the audio device.
properties.id: Holds an identifier for the audio device.
properties.mode: Holds whether this device is an input or output device.

LogValueAxis3DFormatter.description: Provides formatting rules for a logarithmic value axis.

properties.showEdgeLabels: Defines whether the first and last label on the axis are visible.
properties.autoSubGrid: Defines whether sub-grid positions are generated automatically.
properties.base: The base of the logarithm used to map axis values. If the base is non-zero, the parent axis segment count will be ignored when the grid line and label positions are calculated. If you want the range to be divided into equal segments like a normal value axis, set this property value to zero.

properties.frameDuration: Duration of each frame of the animation in milliseconds. Values less than or equal to 0 are invalid.
properties.paused: When paused, the current frame can be advanced manually.
properties.running: Whether the sprite is animating or not.
properties.source: The image source for the animation.
properties.frameWidth: Width of a single frame in this AnimatedSprite.
properties.loops: After playing the animation this many times, the animation will automatically stop. Negative values are invalid.
properties.frameCount: Number of frames in this AnimatedSprite.
properties.frameRate: Frames per second to show in the animation. Values less than or equal to 0 are invalid.
properties.currentFrame: When paused, the current frame can be advanced manually by setting this property or calling advance().
properties.frameY: The Y coordinate in the image file of the first frame of the AnimatedSprite.
properties.reverse: If true, the animation will be played in reverse.
properties.frameSync: If true, the animation will have no duration. Instead, the animation will advance one frame each time a frame is rendered to the screen. This synchronizes it with the painting rate as opposed to elapsed time.
properties.interpolate: If true, interpolation will occur between sprite frames to make the animation appear smoother.
properties.finishBehavior: The behavior when the animation finishes on its own.
properties.frameX: The X coordinate in the image file of the first frame of the AnimatedSprite.
properties.frameHeight: Height of a single frame in this AnimatedSprite.

properties.category: This property holds the name of the settings category.
properties.fileName: This property holds the path to the settings file. If the file doesn't already exist, it is created.

Layer.description: Layer provides a way of filtering which entities will be rendered.

properties.recursive: Specifies if the layer is also applied to the entity subtree.

ratings QML Value Type.description: The ratings type holds place rating information.

properties.count: This property holds the total number of individual user ratings used in determining the overall ratings average.
properties.average: This property holds the average of the individual ratings.
properties.maximum: This property holds the maximum rating value.

AbstractBarSeries.description: An abstract parent type for all bar series types.

properties.axisY: The y-axis used for the series. If you leave both axisY and axisYRight undefined, a ValueAxis is created for the series.
properties.count: The number of bar sets in a bar series.
properties.labelsPrecision: The maximum amount of significant digits shown in value labels.
properties.labelsVisible: The visibility of the labels in a bar series.
properties.axisX: The x-axis used for the series. If you leave both axisX and axisXTop undefined, a BarCategoryAxis is created for the series.
properties.axisYRight: The y-axis used for the series, drawn to the right of the chart view.
properties.labelsAngle: The angle of the value labels in degrees.
properties.labelsFormat: The format used for showing labels in a bar series.
properties.axisXTop: The x-axis used for the series, drawn on top of the chart view.
properties.barWidth: The unit of width is the unit of the x-axis. The minimum width for bars is zero, and negative values are treated as zero. Setting the width to zero means that the width of the bar on the screen is one pixel regardless of the scale of the x-axis. Bars wider than zero are scaled using the x-axis scale.
properties.labelsPosition: The position of the data value labels:

properties.signalArguments: This property holds a list of emitted signal arguments. Each emission of the signal will append one item to the list, containing the arguments of the signal. When connecting to a new target or new signalName or calling the clear() method, the signalArguments will be reset to empty.
properties.signalName: This property defines the name of the signal on target to listen for.
properties.target: This property defines the target object that will be used to listen for emissions of the signalName signal.
properties.count: This property defines the number of times that signalName has been emitted from target since the last call to clear().
properties.valid: This property defines the current signal connection status. It will be true when the signalName of the target is connected successfully, otherwise it will be false.

AxisAccumulator.description: QML frontend for the Qt3DInput::QAxisAccumulator C++ class.

properties.sourceAxis: The Axis for which the accumulator should integrate axis values.
properties.sourceAxisType: The sourceAxisType property specifies how the accumulator treats the values from the source axis.
properties.value: The amount to scale the axis value by when accumulating. This can be thought of as the maximum velocity or acceleration the axis can control.

Animator (Uncreatable).description: Is the base of all QML animators.

properties.target: This property holds the target item of the animator.
properties.duration: This property holds the duration of the animation in milliseconds.
properties.to: This property holds the end value for the animation.
properties.from: This property holds the starting value for the animation.

InputEngine (Uncreatable).description: Maps the user input to the input methods.

properties.inputModes: The list of available input modes is dependent on the input method and locale. This property is updated when either of the dependencies change.
properties.inputMode: Use this property to get or set the current input mode. The InputEngine::inputModes property provides the list of valid input modes for the current input method and locale.
properties.patternRecognitionModes: The list of available pattern recognition modes.
properties.wordCandidateListVisibleHint: Use this property to check if the word candidate list should be visible in the UI.
properties.wordCandidateListModel: Use this property to access the list model for the word candidate list.
properties.inputMethod: Use this property to set the active input method, or to monitor when the active input method changes.

SkyMaterial.description: Renders a procedural sky and generates image-based lighting data.

properties.enableIBL: Determines whether the generated sky cubemap is used for image-based lighting.
properties.skyboxMode: Selects what the SkyMaterial produces for the visible background.
properties.radianceMapSize: Specifies the resolution of the generated environment cubemap used for image-based lighting and reflection probes.
properties.fragmentShaderCode: Specifies inline fragment shader source code.
properties.iblSampleCount: The total number of GGX importance samples evaluated per output texel of the filtered radiance map. Higher values reduce shimmering on high-frequency features such as a sun disk, at the cost of generation time.
properties.fragmentShader: Specifies a fragment shader loaded from a file or resource URL.
properties.iblRenderFrames: Controls how the IBL prefilter work is spread across frames.

properties.currentFrame: The number of the currently displayed animation frame.
properties.direction: This property holds the direction of rendering.
properties.autoPlay: Defines whether the player will start playing animation automatically after the animation file has been loaded.
properties.quality: Speficies the rendering quality of the lottie player. If LowQuality is selected the rendering will happen into a frame buffer object, whereas with other options, the rendering will be done onto QImage (which in turn will be rendered on the screen).
properties.startFrame: Frame number of the start of the animation. The value is available after the animation has been loaded and ready to play.
properties.status: This property holds the current status of the LottieAnimation element.
properties.frameRate: This property holds the frame rate value of the Lottie animation.
properties.source: The source of the Lottie asset that LottieAnimation plays.
properties.loops: This property holds the number of loops the player will repeat. The value LottieAnimation.Infinite means that the the player repeats the animation continuously.
properties.endFrame: Frame number of the end of the animation. The value is available after the animation has been loaded and ready to play.

AudioListener.description: defines the position and orientation of the person listening to a sound field defined by a AudioEngine.

AllOfFilter.description: Combines multiple filters using logical AND in a SortFilterProxyModel.

properties.filters: The list of child filters evaluated with logical AND. A row is accepted if all the filters in this list accepts it.

FolderListModel.description: The FolderListModel provides a model of the contents of a file system folder.

properties.rootFolder: When this property is set, the given folder will be treated as the root in the file system, so that you can only traverse subfolders within it.
properties.showDot: If true, the current "." directory will be included in the model.
properties.showHidden: If true, hidden files and directories are included in the model; otherwise they are excluded.
properties.nameFilters: The nameFilters property contains a list of file name filters. The filters may include the ? and * wildcards.
properties.showDirsFirst: If true, if directories are included in the model they will always be shown first, then the files.
properties.folder: The folder property holds a URL for the folder that the model currently provides.
properties.sortCaseSensitive: If set to true, the sort is case sensitive. This property is true by default.
properties.parentFolder: Returns the URL of the parent of the current folder.
properties.showDotAndDotDot: If true, the "." and ".." directories are included in the model; otherwise they are excluded.
properties.count: Returns the number of items in the current folder that match the filter criteria.
properties.sortReversed: If set to true, reverses the sort order. The default is false.
properties.showOnlyReadable: If true, only readable files and directories are shown; otherwise all files and directories are shown.
properties.showFiles: If true, files are included in the model; otherwise only directories are included.
properties.sortField: The sortField property contains the field to use for sorting. sortField may be one of:
properties.status: This property holds the status of folder reading. It can be one of:
properties.showDotDot: If true, the ".." (parent) directory will be included in the model.
properties.showDirs: If true, directories are included in the model; otherwise only files are included.

SortPolicy.description: Provides storage for the sort types to be used.

properties.sortTypes: Specifies the sorting types to be used.

properties.xVariance: Maximum attribute x value (as a result of Wander).
properties.affectedParameter: What attribute of particles is directly affected.
properties.yVariance: Maximum attribute y value (as a result of Wander).

properties.sceneGrabPosition: The grabbed position within the scene
properties.scenePressPosition: The pressed position within the scene
properties.modifiers: Which modifier keys are currently pressed
properties.id: The ID number of the point
properties.ellipseDiameters: This property holds the diameters of the contact patch, if the event comes from a touchpoint and the device provides this information.
properties.pressure: This property tells how hard the user is pressing the stylus on a graphics tablet or the finger against a touchscreen, in the range from 0 (no measurable pressure) to 1.0 (maximum pressure which the device can measure).
properties.device: This property holds the device that the point (and its event) came from.
properties.pressedButtons: Which mouse or stylus buttons are currently pressed
properties.uniqueId: The unique ID of the point, if any
properties.velocity: A vector representing the average speed and direction of movement
properties.pressPosition: The pressed position within the parent Item
properties.position: The position within the parent Item
properties.rotation: This property holds the rotation angle of the stylus on a graphics tablet or the contact patch of a touchpoint on a touchscreen.

ThresholdMask.description: Masks the source item with another item and applies a threshold value.

properties.maskSource: This property defines the item that is going to be used as the mask. Mask item gets rendered into an intermediate pixel buffer and the alpha values from the result are used to determine the source item's pixels visibility in the display.
properties.source: This property defines the source item that is going to be masked.
properties.threshold: This property defines a threshold value for the mask pixels. The mask pixels that have an alpha value below this property are used to completely mask away the corresponding pixels from the source item. The mask pixels that have a higher alpha value are used to alphablend the source item to the display.
properties.spread: This property defines the smoothness of the mask edges near the threshold alpha value. Setting spread to 0.0 uses mask normally with the specified threshold. Setting higher spread values softens the transition from the transparent mask pixels towards opaque mask pixels by adding interpolated values between them.
properties.cached: This property allows the effect output pixels to be cached in order to improve the rendering performance.

InputHandler3D.description: Basic wheel mouse based input handler.

properties.zoomAtTargetEnabled: Defines whether zooming changes the camera target to the position of the input at the time of the zoom. Defaults to true.
properties.rotationEnabled: Defines whether this input handler allows graph rotation. Defaults to true.
properties.selectionEnabled: Defines whether this input handler allows selection from the graph. Defaults to true.
properties.zoomEnabled: Defines whether this input handler allows graph zooming. Defaults to true.

AbstractInputHandler3D.description: Base type for all QtDataVisualization input handlers.

TabButton.description: Button with a look suitable for a TabBar.

properties.channelMapper: This property holds the ChannelMapper that controls how the channels in the animation clip map onto the properties of the target objects.
properties.running: This property holds a boolean indicating whether the animation is currently running.
properties.loops: This property holds the number of times the animation should play.
properties.clock: The clock controls the speed with which an animation is played.
properties.normalizedTime: This property holds the clips normalized time.

properties.colCount: The number of columns in the array.
properties.rowCount: The number of rows in the array.

AbstractAnimation.description: An abstract base type for Qt3D animations.

properties.animationType: Holds the type of the animation.
properties.animationName: Holds the name of the animation.
properties.position: Holds the current position of the animation.
properties.duration: Holds the duration of the animation.

MorphingAnimation.description: A type implementing blend-shape morphing animation.

properties.easing: Holds the easing curve of the interpolator between morph targets.
properties.targetName: Holds the name of the target geometry. This is a convenience property making it easier to match the target geometry to the morphing animation. The name is usually same as the name of the parent entity of the target GeometryRenderer, but does not have to be.
properties.method: Holds the morphing method. The default is Relative.
properties.targetPositions: Holds the position values of the morph target. Each position in the list specifies the position of the corresponding morph target with the same index. The values must be in an ascending order. Values can be positive or negative and do not have any predefined unit.
properties.morphTargets: Holds the list of morph targets in the morphing animation.
properties.interpolator: Holds the interpolator between base and target attributes.
properties.target: Holds the target GeometryRenderer the morphing animation is applied to.

real QML Value Type.description: a number with a decimal point.

ParticleGroup.description: For setting attributes on a logical particle group.

properties.durationVariation: The maximum number of milliseconds that the duration of the transition cycle varies per particle in the group.
properties.name: This is the name of the particle group, and how it is generally referred to by other elements.
properties.duration: The time in milliseconds before the group will attempt to transition.
properties.system: This is the system which will contain the group.
properties.to: The weighted list of transitions valid for this group.

properties.xyMeshResolution: Holds the x-y resolution of the mesh. The width and height values of this property specify the number of vertices generated for the x-y faces of the mesh.
properties.xExtent: Holds the x extent of the mesh.
properties.yExtent: Holds the y extent of the mesh.
properties.zExtent: Holds the z extent of the mesh.
properties.yzMeshResolution: Holds the y-z resolution of the mesh. The width and height values of this property specify the number of vertices generated for the y-z faces of the mesh.
properties.xzMeshResolution: Holds the x-z resolution of the mesh. The width and height values of this property specify the number of vertices generated for the x-z faces of the mesh.

MultiEffect.description: Applies post-processing effect to an item.

properties.colorization: This property defines how much the source is colorized with the colorizationColor.
properties.shadowScale: This property defines the scale of the shadow. Scaling is applied from the center of the item.
properties.maskSpreadAtMin: This property defines the smoothness of the mask edges near the maskThresholdMin. Setting higher spread values softens the transition from the transparent mask pixels towards opaque mask pixels by adding interpolated values between them.
properties.paddingRect: Set this to increase item size manually so that blur and/or shadows will fit. If autoPaddingEnabled is true and paddingRect is not set, the item is padded to fit maximally blurred item based on blurMax and blurMultiplier. When enabling the shadow, you typically need to take shadowHorizontalOffset and shadowVerticalOffset into account and adjust this paddingRect accordingly.
properties.maskInverted: This property switches the mask to the opposite side; instead of masking away the content outside maskThresholdMin and maskThresholdMax, content between them will get masked away.
properties.blurMultiplier: This property defines a multiplier for extending the blur radius.
properties.shadowHorizontalOffset: This property defines the horizontal offset of the shadow from the item center.
properties.itemRect: Read-only access to effect item rectangle. This can be used e.g. to see the area item covers.
properties.brightness: This property defines how much the source brightness is increased or decreased.
properties.saturation: This property defines how much the source saturation is increased or decreased.
properties.blur: This property defines how much blur (radius) is applied to the source.
properties.blurMax: This property defines the maximum pixel radius that blur with value 1.0 will reach.
properties.maskThresholdMax: This property defines an upper threshold value for the mask pixels. The mask pixels that have an alpha value below this property are used to completely mask away the corresponding pixels from the source item. The mask pixels that have a higher alpha value are used to alphablend the source item to the display.
properties.source: This property holds the item to be used as a source for the effect. If needed, MultiEffect will internally generate a ShaderEffectSource as the texture source.
properties.contrast: This property defines how much the source contrast is increased or decreased.
properties.maskSpreadAtMax: This property defines the smoothness of the mask edges near the maskThresholdMax. Using higher spread values softens the transition from the transparent mask pixels towards opaque mask pixels by adding interpolated values between them.
properties.shadowVerticalOffset: This property defines the vertical offset of the shadow from the item center.
properties.shadowOpacity: This property defines the opacity of the drop shadow. This value is multiplied with the shadowColor alpha value.
properties.vertexShader: Read-only access to filename of the currently used vertex shader.
properties.colorizationColor: This property defines the RGBA color value which is used to colorize the source.
properties.fragmentShader: Read-only access to filename of the currently used fragment shader.
properties.hasProxySource: Returns true when the MultiEffect internally creates ShaderEffectSource for the source item and false when source item is used as-is. For example when source is Image element or Item with layer.enabled set to true, this additional proxy source is not needed.
properties.maskThresholdMin: This property defines a lower threshold value for the mask pixels. The mask pixels that have an alpha value below this property are used to completely mask away the corresponding pixels from the source item. The mask pixels that have a higher alpha value are used to alphablend the source item to the display.
properties.shadowColor: This property defines the RGBA color value which is used for the shadow. It is useful for example when a shadow is used for simulating a glow effect.
properties.autoPaddingEnabled: When blur or shadow effects are enabled and this is set to true (default), the item size is padded automatically based on blurMax and blurMultiplier. Note that paddingRect is always added to the size.
properties.shadowBlur: This property defines how much blur (radius) is applied to the shadow.
properties.maskSource: Source item for the mask effect. Should point to ShaderEffectSource, item with layer.enabled set to true, or to an item that can be directly used as a texture source (for example, Image). The alpha channel of the source item is used for masking.

TextEdit.description: Displays multiple lines of editable formatted text.

properties.canUndo: Returns true if the TextEdit is writable and there are previous operations that can be undone.
properties.cursorVisible: If true the text edit shows a cursor.
properties.mouseSelectionMode: Specifies how text should be selected using a mouse.
properties.cursorPosition: The position of the cursor in the TextEdit. The cursor is positioned between characters.
properties.font.features: Applies integer values to specific OpenType features when shaping the text based on the contents. This provides advanced access to the font shaping process, and can be used to support font features that are otherwise not covered in the API.
properties.inputMethodComposing: This property holds whether the TextEdit has partial text input from an input method.
properties.font.preferTypoLineMetrics: competing sets of the vertical line metrics that provide the ascent, descent and leading of the font. These are often referred to as the win (Windows) metrics and the typo (typographical) metrics. While the specification recommends using the typo metrics for line spacing, many applications prefer the win metrics unless the USE_TYPO_METRICS flag is set in the fsSelection field of the font. For backwards-compatibility reasons, this is also the case for Qt applications. This is not an issue for fonts that set the USE_TYPO_METRICS flag to indicate that the typo metrics are valid, nor for fonts where the win metrics and typo metrics match up. However, for certain fonts the win metrics may be larger than the preferable line spacing and the USE_TYPO_METRICS flag may be unset by mistake. For such fonts, setting font.preferTypoLineMetrics may give superior results.
properties.inputMethodHints: Provides hints to the input method about the expected content of the text edit and how it should operate.
properties.activeFocusOnPress: Whether the TextEdit should gain active focus on a mouse press. By default this is set to true.
properties.length: Returns the total number of plain text characters in the TextEdit item.
properties.preeditText: This property contains partial text input from an input method.
properties.readOnly: Whether the user can interact with the TextEdit item. If this property is set to true the text cannot be edited by user interaction.
properties.renderType: Override the default rendering type for this component.
properties.lineCount: Returns the total number of lines in the TextEdit item.
properties.cursorDelegate: The delegate for the cursor in the TextEdit.
properties.canRedo: Returns true if the TextEdit is writable and there are undone operations that can be redone.
properties.selectionEnd: The cursor position after the last character in the current selection.
properties.tabStopDistance: The default distance, in device units, between tab stops.
properties.textFormat: The way the text property should be displayed.
properties.baseUrl: This property specifies a base URL which is used to resolve relative URLs within the text.
properties.color: The text color.
properties.font.bold: Sets whether the font weight is bold.
properties.font.capitalization: Sets the capitalization for the text.
properties.cursorRectangle: The rectangle where the standard text cursor is rendered within the text edit. Read-only.
properties.font.wordSpacing: Sets the word spacing for the font.
properties.font.styleName: Sets the style name of the font.
properties.overwriteMode: Whether text entered by the user will overwrite existing text.
properties.selectedText: This read-only property provides the text currently selected in the text edit.
properties.selectByKeyboard: Defaults to true when the editor is editable, and false when read-only.
properties.selectedTextColor: The selected text color, used in selections.
properties.canPaste: Returns true if the TextEdit is writable and the content of the clipboard is suitable for pasting into the TextEdit.
properties.font.preferShaping: Sometimes, a font will apply complex rules to a set of characters in order to display them correctly. In some writing systems, such as Brahmic scripts, this is required in order for the text to be legible, but in for example Latin script, it is merely a cosmetic feature. Setting the preferShaping property to false will disable all such features when they are not required, which will improve performance in most cases.
properties.font.strikeout: Sets whether the font has a strikeout style.
properties.selectionColor: The text highlight color, used behind selections.
properties.contentHeight: Returns the height of the text, including the height past the height that is covered if the text does not fit within the set height.
properties.font.underline: Sets whether the text is underlined.
properties.hoveredLink: This property contains the link string when the user hovers a link embedded in the text. The link must be in rich text or HTML format and the link string provides access to the particular link.
properties.selectionStart: The cursor position before the first character in the current selection.
properties.font.contextFontMerging: If the selected font does not contain a certain character, Qt automatically chooses a similar-looking fallback font that contains the character. By default this is done on a character-by-character basis.
properties.font.pixelSize: Sets the font size in pixels.
properties.textDocument: Returns the QQuickTextDocument of this TextEdit. Since Qt 6.7, it has features for loading and saving files. It can also be used in C++ as a means of accessing the underlying QTextDocument instance, for example to install a QSyntaxHighlighter.
properties.font.family: Sets the family name of the font.
properties.font.hintingPreference: Sets the preferred hinting on the text.
properties.font.pointSize: Sets the font size in points. The point size must be greater than zero.
properties.font.letterSpacing: Sets the letter spacing for the font.
properties.font.weight: The requested weight of the font. The weight requested must be an integer between 1 and 1000, or one of the predefined values:
properties.persistentSelection: Whether the TextEdit should keep the selection visible when it loses active focus to another item in the scene. By default this is set to false.
properties.textMargin: The margin, in pixels, around the text in the TextEdit.
properties.font.kerning: Enables or disables the kerning OpenType feature when shaping the text. Disabling this may improve performance when creating or changing the text, at the expense of some cosmetic features. The default value is true.
properties.wrapMode: Set this property to wrap the text to the TextEdit item's width. The text will only wrap if an explicit width has been set.
properties.contentWidth: Returns the width of the text, including the width past the width which is covered due to insufficient wrapping if wrapMode is set.
properties.text: The text to display. If the text format is AutoText the text edit will automatically determine whether the text should be treated as rich text. This determination is made using Qt::mightBeRichText(). However, detection of Markdown is not automatic.
properties.cursorSelection: This property is in technology preview and is subject to change.
properties.font.italic: Sets whether the font has an italic style.
properties.font.variableAxes: Applies floating point values to variable axes in variable fonts.

properties.from: This property holds the starting value for the animation.
properties.to: This property holds the end value for the animation.

Scene2D.description: This type enables rendering qml into a texture, which then can be used as a part of 3D scene.

properties.mouseEnabled: Holds whether mouse events are enabled for the rendered item. The mouse events are generated from object picking events of the entities added to the Scene2D. Mouse is enabled by default.
properties.renderPolicy: Holds the render policy of this Scene2D.
properties.entities: Holds the list of entities which are associated with the Scene2D object. If the entities have ObjectPicker, the pick events from that entity are sent to Scene2D and converted to mouse events.
properties.item: Holds the Item, which is rendered by Scene2D to the texture.
properties.output: Holds the RenderTargetOutput, which specifies where the Scene2D is rendering to.

properties.textures: This property defines a list of Texture resources that will be loaded to the GPU and cached.
properties.geometries: This property defines a list of Geometry resources that will be loaded to the GPU and cached.
properties.meshSources: This property defines a list of locations of mesh files containing geometry. When a mesh file is added to this list, it will be loaded to the GPU and cached. If these same mesh files are source is used by a /c Model they will not need to be loaded again.
