Wander3D.description: Applies random wave curves to particles.

properties.globalAmount: This property defines how long distance each particle moves at the ends of curves. So if the value is for example (100, 10, 0), all particles wander between (100, 10, 0) and (-100, -10, 0).
properties.uniquePaceVariation: This property defines the unique pace (frequency) variation for each particle between 0.0 and 1.0. When the variation is 0.0, every particle wander at the same frequency. For example if uniquePace is (1.0, 2.0, 4.0) and uniquePaceVariation is 0.5, the particles wave paces are something random between (2.0, 4.0, 8.0) and (0.5, 1.0, 2.0).
properties.uniqueAmount: This property defines how long distance each particle moves at the ends of curves at maximum.
properties.fadeInDuration: This property defines the duration in milliseconds for fading in the affector. After this duration, the wandering will be in full effect. Setting this can be useful to emit from a specific position or shape, otherwise wander will affect position also at the beginning.
properties.fadeOutDuration: This property defines the duration in milliseconds for fading out the affector. Setting this can be useful to reduce the wander when the particle life time ends, for example when combined with Attractor3D so end positions will match the shape.
properties.uniqueAmountVariation: This property defines variation for uniqueAmount between 0.0 and 1.0. When the amount variation is 0.0, every particle reaches maximum amount. When it's 0.5, every particle reaches between 0.5 - 1.5 of the amount. For example if uniqueAmount is (100, 50, 20) and uniqueAmountVariation is 0.1, the particles maximum wave distances are something random between (110, 55, 22) and (90, 45, 18).
properties.globalPaceStart: This property defines the starting point for the pace (frequency). The meaningful range is between 0 .. 2 * PI. For example, to animate the x-coordinate of the pace start:
properties.globalPace: This property defines the pace (frequency) each particle wanders in curves per second.
properties.uniquePace: This property defines the unique pace (frequency) each particle wanders in curves per second.

RenderSettings.description: The RenderSettings type holds settings related to rendering process and host the active FrameGraph.

properties.pickingSettings: Holds the current pick settings for the FrameGraph.
properties.renderCapabilities: Holds the details of the supported rendering engine

VCandlestickModelMapper.description: Vertical model mapper for a candlestick series.

properties.lastSetColumn: The column of the model that is used as the data source for the last item. The default value is -1 (invalid mapping).
properties.timestampRow: The row of the model that contains the timestamp values of the candlestick items in the series. The default value is -1 (invalid mapping).
properties.firstSetColumn: The column of the model that is used as the data source for the first item. The default value is -1 (invalid mapping).
properties.series: The CandlestickSeries based object that is used by the mapper.
properties.closeRow: The row of the model that contains the close values of the candlestick items in the series. The default value is -1 (invalid mapping).
properties.lowRow: The row of the model that contains the low values of the candlestick items in the series. The default value is -1 (invalid mapping).
properties.openRow: The row of the model that contains the open values of the candlestick items in the series. The default value is -1 (invalid mapping).
properties.model: The QAbstractItemModel-based model that is used by the mapper. The model must be implemented and exposed to QML.
properties.highRow: The row of the model that contains the high values of the candlestick items in the series. The default value is -1 (invalid mapping).

PhongAlphaMaterial.description: The PhongAlphaMaterial class provides a default implementation of the phong lighting effect with alpha.

properties.alpha: Holds the alpha component of the object which varies between 0 and 1.
properties.destinationAlphaArg: Holds the blend equation destination alpha blending argument.
properties.sourceRgbArg: Holds the blend equation source RGB blending argument.
properties.blendFunctionArg: Holds the blend equation function argument.
properties.destinationRgbArg: Holds the blend equation destination RGB blending argument.
properties.sourceAlphaArg: Holds the blend equation source alpha blending argument.

routeSegment.description: The routeSegment type represents a segment of a Route.

properties.travelTime: Read-only property which holds the estimated amount of time it will take to traverse this segment, in seconds.
properties.path: Read-only property which holds the geographical coordinates of this segment. Coordinates are listed in the order in which they would be traversed by someone traveling along this segment of the route.
properties.distance: Read-only property which holds the distance covered by this segment of the route, in meters.
properties.maneuver: Read-only property which holds the maneuver for this route segment.

WaylandSurface (Uncreatable).description: Represents a rectangular area on an output device.

properties.sourceGeometry: This property describes the portion of the attached Wayland buffer that should be drawn on the screen. The coordinates are from the corner of the buffer and are scaled by bufferScale.
properties.contentOrientation: This property holds the orientation of the WaylandSurface's contents.
properties.destinationSize: This property holds the size of this WaylandSurface in surface coordinates.
properties.bufferScale: This property holds the WaylandSurface's buffer scale. The buffer scale lets a client supply higher resolution buffer data for use on high resolution outputs.
properties.inhibitsIdle: This property holds whether this surface is intended to inhibit the idle behavior of the compositor such as screen blanking, locking and screen saving.
properties.client: This property holds the client using this WaylandSurface.
properties.bufferSize: This property holds the size of the current buffer of this WaylandSurface in pixels, not in surface coordinates.
properties.cursorSurface: This property holds whether the WaylandSurface is a cursor surface.
properties.origin: This property holds the origin of the WaylandSurface's buffer, or WaylandSurface.OriginTopLeft if the surface has no buffer.
properties.useTextureAlpha: This property specifies whether the surface should use texture alpha for blending.
properties.isOpaque: This property holds whether the surface is fully opaque, as reported by the client through the set_opaque_region request.
properties.hasContent: This property holds whether the surface currently has a committed, non-null buffer.

ColumnLayout.description: Identical to GridLayout, but having only one column.

properties.spacing: This property holds the spacing between each cell. The default value is 5.
properties.layoutDirection: This property holds the layout direction of the column layout - it controls the horizontal alignment of items within the column. If Qt.RightToLeft is specified,left-aligned items will be right-aligned and right-aligned items will be left-aligned.
properties.uniformCellSizes: If this property is set to true, the layout will force all cells to have a uniform size.

Easing (Singleton).description: Provides access to the easing enums and convenience API.

GraphPointAnimation.description: An animation type which signifies the animation for points.

properties.animating: Holds the animation state. One of GraphAnimation::AnimationState.

DoubleSpinBox.description: Allows the user to select from a set of preset floating-point values.

properties.inputMethodComposing: This property holds whether an editable spin box has partial text input from an input method.
properties.from: This property holds the starting value for the range. The default value is 0.0.
properties.to: This property holds the end value for the range. The default value is 99.99.
properties.validator: This property holds the input text validator for editable spinboxes. By default, DoubleSpinBox uses DoubleValidator to accept input of double numbers.
properties.decimals: This property holds how many decimals the spinbox will use for displaying and interpreting doubles.
properties.displayText: This property holds the textual value of the spinbox.
properties.stepSize: This property holds the step size. The default value is 1.0.
properties.textFromValue: This property holds a callback function that is called whenever a double value needs to be converted to display text.
properties.inputMethodHints: This property provides hints to the input method about the expected content of the spin box and how it should operate.
properties.editable: This property holds whether the spinbox is editable. The default value is false.
properties.value: This property holds the value in the range from - to. The default value is 0.0.
properties.wrap: This property holds whether the spinbox wraps. The default value is false.
properties.valueFromText: This property holds a callback function that is called whenever input text needs to be converted to a double value.

properties.brushAngle: The amount to rotate the brush noise texture, in degrees. The default value is 45.
properties.brushSize: The scale of the brush. Smaller values yield larger sizes. Sensible values are in the range [10...200]. The default value is 100.
properties.noiseSample: The brush noise texture map. Default is a Texture with source "maps/brushnoise.png".
properties.brushLength: How far to offset the image with the brush. Sensible values are in the range [0...3]. The default value is 1.

properties.Window.contentItem: This attached property holds the invisible root item of the scene or null if the item is not in a window. The Window attached property can be attached to any Item.
properties.visibility: The screen-occupation state of the window.
properties.visible: Whether the window is visible on the screen.
properties.Window.window: This attached property holds the item's window. The Window attached property can be attached to any Item.
properties.flags: The window flags of the window.
properties.contentItem: The invisible root item of the scene.
properties.title: The window's title in the windowing system.
properties.palette: This property holds the palette currently set for the window.
properties.Window.activeFocusItem: This attached property holds the item which currently has active focus or null if there is no item with active focus. The Window attached property can be attached to any Item.
properties.activeFocusItem: The item which currently has active focus or null if there is no item with active focus.
properties.Window.visibility: This attached property holds whether the window is currently shown in the windowing system as normal, minimized, maximized, fullscreen or hidden. The Window attached property can be attached to any Item. If the item is not shown in any window, the value will be Hidden.
properties.screen: The screen with which the window is associated.
properties.Window.active: This attached property tells whether the window is active. The Window attached property can be attached to any Item.
properties.color: The background color for the window.
properties.active: The active status of the window.
properties.transientParent: The window for which this window is a transient pop-up.
properties.contentOrientation: This is a hint to the window manager in case it needs to display additional content like popups, dialogs, status bars, or similar in relation to the window.
properties.data: The data property allows you to freely mix visual children, resources and other Windows in a Window.

ProceduralTextureData.description: Allows creation and population of TextureData from QML.

properties.depth: This property holds the depth of the texture data in pixels. Setting the depth above 0 means that the texture is handled as a 3D texture.
properties.hasTransparency: This property holds whether the texture data has transparency.
properties.textureData: This property holds the texture data.
properties.format: This property holds the format of the texture data.
properties.width: This property holds the width of the texture data in pixels.
properties.height: This property holds the height of the texture data in pixels.

AbstractAxisInput.description: QML frontend for abstract QAbstractAxisInput C++ class.

StackedBarSeries.description: Presents a series of data as vertically stacked bars, with one bar per category.

properties.disableShadowCameraUpdate: When this property is enabled the camera update is disabled for the shadowmap. This means that the view frustum will be locked in space just for the shadowmap calculations. This is just a debug tool to be able to view the camera frustum and shadow map from different angles.
properties.materialOverride: This property changes how all materials are rendered to only reflect a particular aspect of the overall rendering process. This can be used as a debugging tool to get a better understanding of why a material looks the way it does.
properties.drawDirectionalLightShadowBoxes: When this property is enabled a bounding box is drawn for every directional light's shadowmap.
properties.drawCascades: When this property is enabled a frustum is drawn with splits indicating where the shadowmap cascades begin and end.
properties.drawShadowReceivingBounds: When this property is enabled a bounding box is drawn for the shadow receiving objects.
properties.drawSceneCascadeIntersection: When this property is enabled the intersection of the shadowmap cascades and the casting and receiving objects of the scene is drawn.
properties.wireframeEnabled: This property changes how all materials are rendered by changing the polygon fill mode to be lines instead of filled. This appears as a wireframe, but the shaded color will still reflect the respective materials of the meshes.
properties.drawShadowCastingBounds: When this property is enabled a bounding box is drawn for the shadow casting objects.
properties.drawPointLightShadowBoxes: When this property is enabled a bounding box is drawn for every point light's shadowmap.

TableViewDelegate.description: A delegate that can be assigned to a TableView.

properties.tableView: This property points to the TableView that contains the delegate item.
properties.current: This property holds whether or not the delegate represents the current index in the selection model.
properties.editing: This property holds whether or not the delegate is being edited.
properties.selected: This property holds whether or not the delegate represents a selected index in the selection model.

QtRemoteObjects.description: The QtRemoteObjects global object provides useful functions for working with remote types in QML.

properties.Overlay.modal: This attached property holds a component to use as a visual item that implements background dimming for modal popups. It is created for and stacked below visible modal popups.
properties.Overlay.modeless: This attached property holds a component to use as a visual item that implements background dimming for modeless popups. It is created for and stacked below visible dimming popups.
properties.Overlay.overlay: This attached property holds the window overlay item.

properties.hasTransparency: Set this property to true if the instancing table contains alpha values that should be used when rendering the model. This property only makes a difference if the model is opaque: If the model has a transparent material, or an opacity less than one, the alpha value from the table will be used regardless.
properties.shadowBoundsMinimum: Sets the minimum bounds used when calculating the shadow map bounds of the models in the instance table.
properties.shadowBoundsMaximum: Sets the maximum bounds used when calculating the shadow map bounds of the models in the instance table.
properties.instanceCountOverride: Set this property to limit the number of instances without regenerating or re-uploading the instance table. This allows very inexpensive animation of the number of instances rendered.
properties.depthSortingEnabled: Holds the depth sorting enabled value for the instance table. When enabled, instances are sorted and rendered from the furthest instance from the camera to the nearest i.e. back-to-front. If disabled, which is the default, instances are rendered in the order they are specified in the instance table.

ParticlePainter (Uncreatable).description: For specifying how to paint particles.

properties.system: This is the system whose particles can be painted by the element. If the ParticlePainter is a direct child of a ParticleSystem, it will automatically be associated with it.
properties.groups: Which logical particle groups will be painted.

PerspectiveCamera.description: Defines a Perspective Camera for viewing the content of a 3D scene.

properties.clipNear: This property defines the near clip plane of the PerspectiveCamera's frustum. Geometry which is closer to the Camera than the near clip plane will not be visible.
properties.clipFar: This property defines the far clip plane of the PerspectiveCamera's frustum. Geometry which is further away from the Camera than the far clip plane will not be visible.
properties.fieldOfView: This property holds the field of view of the camera in degrees. This can be either the vertical or horizontal field of view depending on whether the fieldOfViewOrientation property is set to PerspectiveCamera.Vertical or PerspectiveCamera.Horizontal.
properties.fieldOfViewOrientation: This property holds the orientation in which camera field of view is given.

Object3D.description: A base type for all the objects in a 3D scene.

properties.position: The 3D position of the object.

RenderablesFilter.description: Defines a filter for selecting which renderables to affect in a pass.

properties.renderableTypes: Sets the types of renderables that the filter will affect.
properties.layerMask: Sets the layer mask for the filter. Only renderables on the specified layers will be affected by the filter.

Application (Singleton).description: Provides access to global application state properties shared by many QML components.

properties.state: This property represents the current state of the application.
properties.displayName: This property represents the application display name set on the QGuiApplication instance. This property can be written to in order to set the application display name.
properties.styleHints: The styleHints property provides platform-specific style hints and settings. See the QStyleHints documentation for further details.
properties.name: This is the application name set on the QCoreApplication instance. This property can be written to in order to set the application name.
properties.screens: An array containing the descriptions of all connected screens. The elements of the array are objects with the same properties as the Screen attached object. In practice the array corresponds to the screen list returned by QGuiApplication::screens(). In addition to examining properties like name, width, height, etc., the array elements can also be assigned to the screen property of Window items, thus serving as an alternative to the C++ side's QWindow::setScreen().
properties.font: Returns the default application font as returned by QGuiApplication::font().
properties.domain: This is the organization domain set on the QCoreApplication instance. This property can be written to in order to set the organization domain.
properties.organization: This is the organization name set on the QCoreApplication instance. This property can be written to in order to set the organization name.
properties.supportsMultipleWindows: Returns true if the platform supports multiple windows. Some embedded platforms do not support multiple windows, for example.
properties.version: This is the application version set on the QCoreApplication instance. This property can be written to in order to set the application version.
properties.layoutDirection: This read-only property can be used to query the default layout direction of the application. On system start-up, the default layout direction depends on the application's language. The property has a value of Qt.RightToLeft in locales where text and graphic elements are read from right to left, and Qt.LeftToRight where the reading direction flows from left to right. You can bind to this property to customize your application layouts to support both layout directions.
properties.arguments: This is a string list of the arguments the executable was invoked with.

PathInterpolator.description: Specifies how to manually animate along a path.

properties.angle: This property holds the angle of the path tangent at progress.
properties.progress: This property holds the current progress along the path.
properties.path: This property holds the path to interpolate.

YAnimator.description: The YAnimator type animates the y position of an Item.

properties.axisZ: Holds the GraphsLine of the Z axis.
properties.axisYLabelFont: Sets the font to be used for labels on axisY.
properties.backgroundVisible: Defines whether the view background is drawn by using the value of backgroundColor. The default value is true.
properties.singleHighlightColor: The highlight color for a selected object. Used if selectionMode has the Graphs3D.SelectionFlag.Item flag set. The default value depends on colorScheme.
properties.backgroundColor: The color of the view the graph is drawn into. The default value depends on colorScheme.
properties.multiHighlightGradient: The highlight gradient for selected objects. Used if selectionMode has the Graphs3D.SelectionFlag.Row or Graphs3D.SelectionFlag.Column flag set. The default value depends on colorScheme.
properties.theme: The type of the theme. If no type is set, the type is GraphsTheme.Theme.QtGreen. Changing the theme type after the item has been constructed will change all other properties of the theme to what the predefined theme specifies. Changing the theme type of the active theme of the graph will also reset all attached series to use the new theme.
properties.GraphsLine.labelTextColor: The color of the text used for labels. The default value depends on colorScheme.
properties.colorScheme: The color scheme of the graph in use.
properties.axisY: Holds the GraphsLine of the Y axis.
properties.labelBackgroundColor: The color of the label backgrounds. Has no effect if labelBackgroundVisible is false. The default value depends on colorScheme.
properties.axisX: Holds the GraphsLine of the X axis.
properties.GraphsLine.subColor: The color of the sub lines. The default value depends on colorScheme.
properties.labelBackgroundVisible: Defines whether the label is drawn with a background that uses labelBackgroundColor (including alpha), or with a fully transparent background. Labels with a background are drawn to equal sizes per axis based on the longest label, and the text is centered in them. Labels without a background are drawn as is and are left or right aligned based on their position in the graph. The default value is true.
properties.labelTextColor: The color of the font used for labels.
properties.GraphsLine.mainWidth: The width of the main lines. The default value is 2.0.
properties.baseGradients: The list of base gradients to be used for all the objects in the graph, series by series. If there are more series than gradients, the gradient list wraps and starts again with the first gradient in the list.
properties.labelsVisible: Defines whether labels are drawn at all. If this is false, all other label properties have no effect. The default value is true.
properties.seriesColors: The list of colors to be used for all the objects in the graph, series by series. If there are more series than colors, color list wraps and starts again with the first color in the list. Has no immediate effect if colorStyle is not GraphsTheme.ColorStyle.Uniform.
properties.baseColors: The list of base colors of type Color to be used for all the objects in the graph, series by series. If there are more series than colors, color list wraps and starts again with the first color in the list. Has no immediate effect if colorStyle is not GraphsTheme.ColorStyle.Uniform.
properties.labelFont: Sets the font to be used for labels.
properties.labelBorderVisible: Defines whether label borders are drawn for labels that have a background. Has no effect if labelBackgroundVisible is false. The default value is true.
properties.plotAreaBackgroundColor: The color of the graph plot area background. The default value depends on colorScheme.
properties.singleHighlightGradient: The highlight gradient for a selected object. Used if selectionMode has the Graphs3D.SelectionFlag.Item flag set. The default value depends on colorScheme.
properties.axisZLabelFont: Sets the font to be used for labels on axisZ.
properties.plotAreaBackgroundVisible: Defines whether the plot area background is drawn by using the value of plotAreaBackgroundColor. The default value is true.
properties.GraphsLine.mainColor: The color of the main lines. The default value depends on colorScheme.
properties.grid: Holds the GraphsLine of the theme.
properties.gridVisible: Defines whether the grid lines are drawn. This value affects all grid lines. The default value is true.
properties.multiHighlightColor: The highlight color for selected objects. Used if selectionMode has the Graphs3D.SelectionFlag.Row or Graphs3D.SelectionFlag.Column flag set. The default value depends on colorScheme.
properties.colorStyle: The style of the graph colors. One of QGraphsTheme::ColorStyle enum values.
properties.axisXLabelFont: Sets the font to be used for labels on axisX.
properties.borderColors: The list of border colors to be used for all the objects in the graph, series by series.
properties.GraphsLine.subWidth: The width of the sub lines. The default value is 1.0.

InvokedServices.description: Provices access to the services invoked by state machines.

properties.children: The services invoked by the state machine.
properties.qmlChildren: A list of additional QtObject types nested in this type.
properties.stateMachine: The state machine that invoked the services.

ExtendedSceneEnvironment.description: A SceneEnvironment providing commonly used rendering effects.

properties.whitePoint: Reference value for white when tonemapping is enabled. The value must be larger than 0.
properties.ssgiSampleCount: Configures the global illumination algorithm. A higher sample count will give better results at the expense of increased GPU load.
properties.ssgiBufferSizeFactor: Controls the size of the color buffers the SSGI effect works on. Performing everything with render targets matching the input and output dimensions (i.e., the View3D's pixel size) can be too costly which many GPUs and devices cannot afford in practice. Therefore, the SSGI effect operates on a reduced size for intermediate textures. By default this is 0.5, meaning half the size of the input and output textures. Increasing the value towards 1 increases the quality of the results, at the expense of a heavily growing GPU load.
properties.lensFlareStretchToAspect: Set correction factor for roundness of the lens flare halo.
properties.adjustmentSaturation: Adjusts the saturation of the scene.
properties.lutFilterAlpha: Sets the amount of color grading to mix with the scene. The value is expected to be between 0 and 1.
properties.adjustmentBrightness: Adjusts the brightness of the scene.
properties.glowHDRMinimumValue: Sets the minimum brightness of the glow, in high dynamic range. Expected values are in the range 0 to 4.
properties.glowQualityHigh: Increases the samples used for the glow when downsampling to improve the quality of the glow effect.
properties.lensFlareLensDirtTexture: An image that is used to simulate inperfections on the lens.
properties.ssgiIndirectLightEnabled: Controls whether indirect light is included in the result, or only ambient occlusion. By default both are enabled.
properties.glowUseBicubicUpscale: Reduces the aliasing artifacts and boxing in the glow effect.
properties.lutTexture: Source of look-up texture. If no texture is set a built-in identity table is used.
properties.lensFlareGhostCount: Sets the amount of lens flare ghosts. Expected values are from 0 to 20.
properties.glowStrength: Glow strength. Acceptable values are from 0 to 2.
properties.lutSize: Sets the size of the LUT texture. The texture should have the dimensions:
properties.sharpnessAmount: Set the sharpening amount. Valid values are from 0.0 (off) to 1.0 (full).
properties.ssgiSimulatedBounceEnabled: Controls whether additional light bouncing is simulated by sampling the previous frame's texture.
properties.vignetteRadius: Sets the radius of the vignette effect. Ranges from 0 to 5.
properties.glowIntensity: Glow intensity. Expected values are in the range 0 to 8.
properties.lensFlareBloomBias: Sets the level at which the lens flare bloom starts.
properties.glowBlendMode: Blending mode for the glow effect.
properties.vignetteStrength: Sets the strength of the vignette effect. Ranges from 0 to 15.
properties.ssgiEnabled: Enables screen-space global illumination. This effect increases realism by adding ambient occlusion and indirect light to the scene.
properties.glowEnabled: Enables the glow effect. It can also provide bloom, when the value of glowBloom is larger than 0.
properties.lensFlareHaloWidth: Sets the size of the lens flare halo. Ranges from 0 to 1.
properties.lensFlareBlurAmount: Set amount of blur to apply to the lens flare. Ranges from 0 to 50.
properties.lensFlareGhostDispersal: Sets the distance between the lens flare ghosts. Expected values are between 0 and 5. The value should be larger than 0.
properties.glowLevel: Sets which of the blur passes get applied to the glow effect. There are a total of 7 levels available.
properties.lensFlareDistortion: Set amount of chromatic aberration in the lens flare. Expected values ranges from 0 to 20.
properties.ssrEnabled: Enables screen-space reflections, a post-processing technique that creates reflections by using data rendered on the screen.
properties.lensFlareCameraDirection: Sets the direction of the camera in the scene.
properties.adjustmentContrast: Adjusts the contrast of the scene.
properties.glowBloom: Sets the amount of bloom applied to the glow effect. Values from 0 to 1 are expected.
properties.glowHDRMaximumValue: Sets the maximum brightness of the glow, in high dynamic range. Value range is from 0 to 256.
properties.depthOfFieldFocusDistance: Sets the distance from the camera at which objects are in focus.
properties.depthOfFieldEnabled: Enables the depth of field blur effect.
properties.lensFlareApplyDirtTexture: Set whether to apply a dirt texture to the lens flare.
properties.ssgiIndirectLightBoost: Multiplier for the indirect light results. Increasing the value makes the indirect light contribution more prominent. The suggested range is 1 to 100. The appropriate value always depends on the scene and how it is lit.
properties.glowHDRScale: The bleed scale of the HDR glow. Expected values are in the range 0 to 8.
properties.lensFlareApplyStarburstTexture: Set whether to apply a starburst texture to the lens flare.
properties.lensFlareBloomScale: Sets the scale of the lens flare bloom effect. Expected scale value ranges from 0 to 20.
properties.depthOfFieldBlurAmount: Sets the amount of blur applied to objects outside the focus range. Sensible values are in the range 0 to 10. A value of 0 applies no additional blur.
properties.vignetteColor: Sets the color of the vignette effect.
properties.tonemapMode: This property defines how colors are tonemapped before rendering. All rendering in Qt Quick 3D is performed in linear color space and can in many cases lead to generating color values that are not displayable. The tonemapMode determines the technique that is used to remap colors into a displayable range.
properties.ssgiSimulatedBounceFactor: Multiplier for the result from the simulated bounce calculation. Only has an effect when ssgiSimulatedBounceEnabled is true. This value may need to be tuned together with ssgiIndirectLightBoost. Depending on the scene and how it is lit, higher values for these properties can lead to overly exaggerated indirect light contribution, and even a feedback loop where the indirect light grows excessively between frames.
properties.ditheringEnabled: Enables dithering to reduce banding artifacts.
properties.exposure: Exposure level used by the tonemapper.
properties.ssrMaxSteps: Limits how many steps the reflection ray can take across the screen. Larger values improve reflection reach and quality, but reduces performance.
properties.lensFlareLensStarburstTexture: A noise image to augment the starburst effect of the lens flare. Has an effect only when lensFlareApplyStarburstTexture is enabled.
properties.depthOfFieldFocusRange: The distance around the depthOfFieldFocusDistance where items are fully in focus. The focus then fades away to fully blurred by the same distance on both the near and far sides.
properties.lutEnabled: Enables color grading with look-up tables (LUTs). The look-up table is given as a texture.
properties.lensFlareLensColorTexture: A gradient image used for the lens flare lens color.
properties.ssrThickness: Assumed thickness of scene geometry used by screen-space reflections. Larger values reduce reflection breakups (similar to shadow acne) but may cause reflections to look physically incorrect.

properties.visualPosition: This property holds the visual position of the thumb indicator.
properties.position: This property holds the logical position of the thumb indicator.

Entity.description: Entity is a Node subclass that can aggregate several Component3D instances that will specify its behavior.

properties.components: Holds the list of Component3D instances, which define the behavior of the entity.

properties.meshResolution: Holds the plane resolution. The width and height values of this property specify the number of vertices generated for the mesh in the respective dimensions.
properties.mirrored: Controls if the UV coordinates of the plane should be flipped vertically.

DoubleValidator.description: Defines a validator for non-integer numbers.

properties.bottom: This property holds the validator's minimum acceptable value. By default, this property contains a value of -infinity.
properties.locale: This property holds the name of the locale used to interpret the number.
properties.notation: This property holds the notation of how a string can describe a number.
properties.decimals: This property holds the validator's maximum number of digits after the decimal point. By default, this property contains a value of 1000.
properties.top: This property holds the validator's maximum acceptable value. By default, this property contains a value of infinity.

Gravity.description: For applying acceleration in an angle.

properties.magnitude: Pixels per second that objects will be accelerated by.

ScriptAction.description: Defines scripts to be run during an animation.

properties.script: This property holds the script to run.
properties.scriptName: This property holds the name of the StateChangeScript to run.

Bar3DSeries.description: Represents a data series in a 3D bar graph.

properties.rowColors: This property can be used to draw the rows of the series in different colors. The Theme3D.colorStyle must be set to ColorStyleUniform to use this property.
properties.meshAngle: A convenience property for defining the series rotation angle in degrees.
properties.invalidSelectionPosition: A constant property providing an invalid position for selection. This position is set to the selectedBar property to clear the selection from this series.
properties.selectedBar: The bar in the series that is selected.
properties.dataProxy: The active data proxy. The series assumes ownership of any proxy set to it and deletes any previously set proxy when a new one is added. The proxy cannot be null or set to another series.

ToolSeparator.description: Separates a group of items in a toolbar from adjacent items.

properties.orientation: This property holds the orientation of the tool separator.
properties.vertical: This property holds whether orientation is equal to Qt.Vertical.
properties.horizontal: This property holds whether orientation is equal to Qt.Horizontal.

ModelParticle3D.description: Particle using a Qt Quick 3D Model.

properties.delegate: The delegate provides a template defining each object instantiated by the particle.
properties.instanceTable: The instanceTable provides access to the Instancing table of the model particle. ModelParticle3D uses an internal instance table to implement efficient rendering. This table can be applied to the instancing property of models that are not part of the particle system.

BlendedClipAnimator.description: BlendedClipAnimator is a component providing animation playback capabilities of a tree of blend nodes.

properties.blendTree: This property holds the root of the animation blend tree that will be evaluated before being interpolated by the animator.

properties.currentEndpoint: An endpoint description of the server to which the connection is connected to. When the connection is not established, an empty endpoint description is returned.
properties.defaultConnection: Makes this the default connection. Usually each node needs to be given a connection to use. If this property is set to true, this connection will be used in all cases where a node has no connection set. Already established connections are not affected. If defaultConnection is set to true on multiple connection the last one is used.
properties.connected: Status of the connection. true when there is a connection, otherwise false.
properties.availableBackends: Returns the names of all available backends as a list. These are used to select a backend when connecting.
properties.supportedUserTokenTypes: An array of user token policy types of all supported user token types.
properties.connection: This property is used only to inject a connection from C++. In case of complex setup of a connection you can use C++ to handle all the details. After the connection is established it can be handed to QML using this property. Ownership of the client is transferred to QML.
properties.supportedSecurityPolicies: A list of strings containing the supported security policies
properties.authenticationInformation: Set the authentication information to this connection. The authentication information has to be set before calling connectToEndpoint. If no authentication information is set, the anonymous mode will be used. It has no effect on the current connection. If the client is disconnected and then reconnected, the new credentials are used. Reading and writing this property before a backend is set, writes are ignored and reads return and invalid AuthenticationInformation.
properties.namespaces: List of strings of all namespace URIs registered on the connected server.
properties.backend: Set the backend to use for a connection to the server. Has to be set before any connection attempt.

TreeViewDelegate.description: A delegate that can be assigned to a TreeView.

properties.hasChildren: This property is true if the model item drawn by the delegate has children in the model.
properties.indentation: This property holds the space a child is indented horizontally relative to its parent.
properties.isTreeNode: This property is true if the delegate item draws a node in the tree. Only one column in the view will be used to draw the tree, and therefore, only delegate items in that column will have this property set to true.
properties.leftMargin: This property holds the space between the left edge of the view and the left edge of the indicator (in addition to indentation). If no indicator is visible, the space will be between the left edge of the view and the left edge of the contentItem.
properties.treeView: This property points to the TreeView that contains the delegate item.
properties.current: This property holds if the delegate represent the current index in the selection model.
properties.rightMargin: This property holds the space between the right edge of the view and the right edge of the contentItem.
properties.depth: This property holds the depth of the model item drawn by the delegate. The depth of a model item is the same as the number of ancestors it has in the model.
properties.editing: This property holds if the delegate is being edited.
properties.expanded: This property is true if the model item drawn by the delegate is expanded in the view.
properties.selected: This property holds if the delegate represent a selected index in the selection model.

ScaleAnimator.description: The ScaleAnimator type animates the scale factor of an Item.

Custom3DItem.description: Adds a custom item to a graph.

properties.visible: The visibility of the item. Defaults to true.
properties.meshFile: The item mesh file name. The item in the file must be in Wavefront OBJ format and include vertices, normals, and UVs. It also needs to be in triangles. If the file is missing either normals or UVs, loading will fail with an error message to the console output and the item will not be rendered.
properties.scaling: The item scaling as a vector3d type. Defaults to vector3d(0.1, 0.1, 0.1).
properties.scalingAbsolute: Defines whether item scaling is to be handled in data values or in absolute values. Defaults to true. Items with absolute scaling will be rendered at the same size, regardless of axis ranges. Items with data scaling will change their apparent size according to the axis ranges. If positionAbsolute is true, this property is ignored and scaling is interpreted as an absolute value. If the item has rotation, the data scaling is calculated on the unrotated item. Similarly, for Custom3DVolume items, the range clipping is calculated on the unrotated item.
properties.rotation: The item rotation as a quaternion. Defaults to quaternion(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0).
properties.position: The item position as a vector3d type. Defaults to vector3d(0.0, 0.0, 0.0).
properties.shadowCasting: Defines whether shadow casting for the item is enabled. Defaults to true. If false, the item does not cast shadows regardless of ShadowQuality.
properties.textureFile: The texture file name for the item. If left unset, a solid gray texture will be used.
properties.positionAbsolute: Defines whether item position is to be handled in data coordinates or in absolute coordinates. Defaults to false. Items with absolute coordinates will always be rendered, whereas items with data coordinates are only rendered if they are within axis ranges.

properties.bounds: This property describes the extents of the bounding volume around the imported model.
properties.source: This property holds the location of the source file containing the 3D asset. Changing this property will unload the current asset and attempt to load an asset from the given URL.
properties.status: This property holds the status of the latest load operation.
properties.errorString: This property holds a human-readable string indicating the status of the latest load operation.
properties.instancing: If this property is set, the imported model will not be rendered normally. Instead, a number of instances will be rendered, as defined by the instance table.

PathPolyline.description: Defines a polyline through a list of coordinates.

properties.path: This property defines the vertices of the polyline.
properties.start: This read-only property contains the beginning of the polyline.

RenderTarget.description: The RenderTarget class encapsulates a target (usually a frame buffer object) which the renderer can render into.

properties.attachments: Holds the attachments for the RenderTarget.

StencilMask.description: The StencilMask type controls the front and back writing of individual bits in the stencil planes.

properties.backOutputMask: Holds the write mask for the fragment stencil values for back-facing polygons.
properties.frontOutputMask: Holds the write mask for the fragment stencil values for front-facing polygons.

properties.unifiedColorVariation: This property defines if the colorVariation should be applied uniformly for all the color channels. This means that all variations are applied with the same random amount.
properties.colorVariation: This property defines the color variation that is used for colorizing the particles. The values are in RGBA order and each value should be between 0.0 (no variation) and 1.0 (full variation).
properties.alignMode: This property defines the align mode used for the particles. Particle alignment means the direction that particles face.
properties.fadeOutDuration: This property defines the duration in milliseconds for the fading out effect.
properties.SortMode: Defines the sorting mode of the particle. The sorting mode determines the order in which the particles are drawn.
properties.fadeOutEffect: This property defines the fading effect used when the particles reach their lifeSpan and disappear.
properties.alignTargetPosition: This property defines the position particles are aligned to. This property has effect only when the alignMode is set to Particle3D.AlignTowardsTarget.
properties.fadeInEffect: This property defines the fading effect used when the particles appear.
properties.maxAmount: This property defines the maximum amount of particles that can exist at the same time. You can use particlesUsed for debugging how efficiently the allocated particles are used. If the maxAmount is too small, particles are reused before they reach the end of their lifeSpan. If the maxAmount is too big, unnecessary memory is allocated for the particles.
properties.AlignMode: Defines the type of the alignment.
properties.color: This property defines the base color that is used for colorizing the particles.
properties.hasTransparency: This property defines if the particle has any transparency and should be blended with the background. Usually this should be true, like when the particle color doesn't have full alpha, texture contains semi-transparent pixels or particles opacity is faded in or out. Setting this to false can be an optimization in specific cases.
properties.sortMode: This property defines the sort mode used for the particles.
properties.fadeInDuration: This property defines the duration in milliseconds for the fading in effect.
properties.FadeType: Defines the type of the fading effect.

ItemGrabResult.description: Contains the results from a call to Item::grabToImage().

properties.url: This property holds a URL which can be used in conjunction with URL based image consumers, such as the QtQuick::Image type.
properties.image: This property holds the pixel results from a grab in the form of a QImage.

StringSorter.description: Sort data in a SortFilterProxyModel based on ordering of the locale.

properties.ignorePunctuation: This property holds whether the sorter ignores punctation. If ignorePunctuation is true, punctuation characters and symbols are ignored when determining sort order.
properties.locale: This property holds the locale of the sorter.
properties.numericMode: This property holds whether the numeric mode of the sorter is enabled.
properties.caseSensitivity: This property holds the case sensitivity of the sorter.

properties.defaultButton: This property holds whether this item is the default button of a dialog.
properties.checked: This property holds whether this item is currently checked.
properties.expanded: This property holds whether this item is currently expanded.
properties.id: This property sets an identifier for the object. It can be used to provide stable identifiers to UI tests. By default, the identifier is set to the ID of the QML object. If the ID is not set the default of QAccessible::Identifier is used.
properties.labelledBy: This property holds the item that is used as a label for this item.
properties.passwordEdit: This property holds whether this item is a password text edit.
properties.multiLine: This property holds whether this item has multiple text lines.
properties.ignored: This property holds whether this item should be ignored by the accessibility framework.
properties.checkable: This property holds whether this item is checkable (like a check box or some buttons).
properties.description: This property sets an accessible description. Similar to the name it describes the item. The description can be a little more verbose and tell what the item does, for example the functionality of the button it describes.
properties.editable: This property holds whether this item has editable text.
properties.checkStateMixed: This property holds whether this item is in the partially checked state.
properties.expandable: This property holds whether this item is expandable.
properties.focused: This property holds whether this item currently has the active focus.
properties.name: This property sets an accessible name. For a button for example, this should have a binding to its text. In general this property should be set to a simple and concise but human readable name. Do not include the type of control you want to represent but just the name.
properties.selectableText: This property holds whether this item contains selectable text.
properties.selected: This property holds whether this item is selected.
properties.readOnly: This property indicates that a text field is read only.
properties.role: This flags sets the semantic type of the widget. A button for example would have "Button" as type. The value must be one of QAccessible::Role.
properties.selectable: This property holds whether this item can be selected.
properties.focusable: This property holds whether this item is focusable.
properties.searchEdit: This property holds whether this item is input for a search query. This property will only affect editable text.
properties.pressed: This property holds whether this item is pressed (for example a button during a mouse click).
properties.labelFor: This property holds the item that this item is a label for.

Text2DEntity.description: Text2DEntity allows creation of a 2D text in 3D space.

properties.width: Holds the width of the text's bounding rectangle.
properties.text: Holds the text used for the mesh.
properties.font: Holds the font of the text.
properties.alignment: * * * Holds the alignment of the text.
properties.color: Holds the color of the text.
properties.height: Holds the height of the text's bounding rectangle.

MultiObjectRegistryRef.description: This type is used to access objects registered with ObjectRegistry type.

properties.objects: This property provides the objects referenced by this instance. The order of the objects in this list is not guaranteed to match the order of their registration.

ContentLayer.description: Singleton providing layer flag constants for grouping and filtering scene nodes.

properties.targetTransformAroundCursor: Whether the target should automatically be repositioned in such a way that it is transformed around the mouse cursor position while the property is adjusted. The default is true.
properties.invertible: Whether or not to reverse the direction of property change if QWheelEvent::inverted is true. The default is true.
properties.activeTimeout: The amount of time in seconds after which the active property will revert to false if no more wheel events are received. The default is 0.1 (100 ms).
properties.parent: The Item which is the scope of the handler; the Item in which it was declared. The handler will handle events on behalf of this Item, which means a pointer event is relevant if at least one of its eventPoints occurs within the Item's interior. Initially target() is the same, but it can be reassigned.
properties.rotationScale: The scaling to be applied to the rotation property, and to the property on the target item, if any. The default is 1, such that rotation will be in units of degrees of rotation. It can be set to a negative number to invert the effect of the direction of mouse wheel rotation.
properties.acceptedModifiers: If this property is set, it will require the given keyboard modifiers to be pressed in order to react to wheel events, and otherwise ignore them.
properties.acceptedDevices: The types of pointing devices that can activate this handler.
properties.margin: The margin beyond the bounds of the parent item within which the WheelHandler can react. For example if margin is set to 10, you could place the cursor up to 10 pixels outside the visible edge of the item, and it will still react to the wheel:
properties.blocking: Whether this handler prevents other items or handlers behind it from handling the same wheel event. This property is true by default.
properties.target: The Item which this handler will manipulate.
properties.active: This holds true whenever the WheelHandler has recently seen a QWheelEvent, is keeping its properties up-to-date, and actively manipulating its target (if any).
properties.orientation: Which wheel to react to. The default is Qt.Vertical.
properties.enabled: If a PointerHandler is disabled, it will reject all events and no signals will be emitted.
properties.point: The eventPoint currently being handled. When no point is currently being handled, this object is reset to default values (all coordinates are 0).
properties.rotation: The angle through which the mouse wheel has been rotated since the last time this property was set, in wheel degrees.
properties.targetScaleMultiplier: The amount by which the target scale is to be multiplied whenever the rotation changes by 15 degrees. This is relevant only when property is "scale".
properties.property: The property to be modified on the target when the mouse wheel is rotated.

TargetDirection.description: For specifying a direction towards the target point.

properties.proportionalMagnitude: If true, then the value of magnitude and magnitudeVariation shall be interpreted as multiples of the distance between the source point and the target point, per second.
properties.targetItem: If specified, this will take precedence over targetX and targetY. The targeted point will be the center of the specified Item

conicalgradient2d QML Value Type.description: Provides conicalgradient2d type matching to QCanvasConicalGradient.

SequentialAnimation.description: Allows animations to be run sequentially.

properties.keyframes: A list of keyframes that belong to the keyframe group.
properties.target: The item that is targeted by the keyframe group.
properties.property: The property that is targeted by the keyframe group.
properties.keyframeSource: The URL to a file containing binary keyframe data.

Fog.description: Specifies fog settings for a scene.

properties.depthFar: Ending distance from the camera. The default value is 1000.0. Applicable only when depthEnabled is set to true.
properties.color: The color of the fog. The default value is "#8099b3"
properties.depthNear: Starting distance from the camera. The default value is 10.0. Applicable only when depthEnabled is set to true.
properties.heightCurve: Specifies the intensity of the height fog. The default value is 1.0. Applicable only when heightEnabled is set to true.
properties.density: Controls the fog amount, in practice this is a multiplier in range 0-1. The default value is 1.0. Reducing the value decreases the strength of the fog effect. Applicable only when depthEnabled is set to true.
properties.leastIntenseY: Specifies the position (Y coordinate) where the fog is the least intense. The default value is 10.0. Applicable only when heightEnabled is set to true.
properties.transmitCurve: Intensity of the light transmission effect. The default value is 1.0. Applicable only when transmitEnabled is set to true.
properties.transmitEnabled: Controls if the fog has a light transmission effect. The default value is false.
properties.depthEnabled: Controls if the fog appears in the distance. The default value is false.
properties.enabled: Controls whether fog is applied to the scene. The default value is false.
properties.heightEnabled: Controls if a height fog is enabled. The default value is false.
properties.mostIntenseY: Specifies the position (Y coordinate) where the fog is the most intense. The default value is 0. Applicable only when heightEnabled is set to true.

Direction3D.description: Directions assign velocity for the emitted particles.

DynamicRigidBody.description: A physical body that can move or be moved.

properties.gravityEnabled: This property defines whether the object is going to be affected by gravity or not.
properties.linearAxisLock: This property locks the linear velocity of the body along the axes defined by the DynamicRigidBody.AxisLock enum. To lock several axes just bitwise-or their enum values.
properties.kinematicPosition: Defines the position of the object when it is kinematic, i.e. when isKinematic is set to true. On each iteration of the simulation the physical object will be updated according to this value.
properties.centerOfMassPosition: Defines the position of the center of mass relative to the body. Note that this is only used when massMode is set to DynamicRigidBody.MassAndInertiaTensor.
properties.density: This property defines the density of the body. This is only used when massMode is set to DynamicRigidBody.CustomDensity.
properties.mass: This property defines the mass of the body. Note that this is only used when massMode is not DynamicRigidBody.CustomDensity or DynamicRigidBody.DefaultDensity. Also note that a value of 0 is interpreted as infinite mass and that negative numbers are not allowed.
properties.massMode: This property holds the enum which describes how mass and inertia are calculated for this body.
properties.isKinematic: This property defines whether the object is kinematic or not. A kinematic object does not get influenced by external forces and can be seen as an object of infinite mass. If this property is set then in every simulation frame the physical object will be moved to its target position regardless of external forces. Note that to move and rotate the kinematic object you need to use the kinematicPosition, kinematicRotation, kinematicEulerRotation and kinematicPivot properties.
properties.kinematicEulerRotation: Defines the euler rotation of the object when it is kinematic, i.e. when isKinematic is set to true. On each iteration of the simulation the physical object will be updated according to this value.
properties.inertiaTensor: Defines the inertia tensor vector, using a parameter specified in mass space coordinates.
properties.centerOfMassRotation: Defines the rotation of the center of mass pose, i.e. it specifies the orientation of the body's principal inertia axes relative to the body. Note that this is only used when massMode is set to DynamicRigidBody.MassAndInertiaTensor.
properties.isSleeping: Is set to true if the body is sleeping. While it is technically possible to set this property it should be seen as a read-only property that is set on every frame the physics simulation is running.
properties.kinematicRotation: Defines the rotation of the object when it is kinematic, i.e. when isKinematic is set to true. On each iteration of the simulation the physical object will be updated according to this value.
properties.kinematicPivot: Defines the pivot of the object when it is kinematic, i.e. when isKinematic is set to true. On each iteration of the simulation the physical object will be updated according to this value.
properties.angularAxisLock: This property locks the angular velocity of the body along the axes defined by the DynamicRigidBody.AxisLock enum. To lock several axes just bitwise-or their enum values.
properties.inertiaMatrix: Defines the inertia tensor matrix. This is a 3x3 matrix in column-major order. Note that this matrix is expected to be diagonalizable. Note that this is only used when massMode is set to DynamicRigidBody.MassAndInertiaMatrix.

RotationAnimator.description: The RotationAnimator type animates the rotation of an Item.

properties.direction: This property holds the direction of the rotation.

TextureProviderExtension (Uncreatable).description: Abstract base type for render extensions that produce a texture.

properties.samplerHint: This property contains a hint about the type of texture that will be provided by the extension. This is necessary because the texture data will not be provided until it is necessary, but materials that use the Texture component need to know what type of sampler to provide.

GradientStop.description: Defines the color at a position in a Gradient.

RenderStateSet.description: The RenderStateSet FrameGraph node offers a way of specifying a set of RenderState objects to be applied during the execution of a framegraph branch.

properties.renderStates: Holds the list of RenderState objects used by the RenderStateSet.

StencilOperationArguments.description: The StencilOperationArguments type sets the actions to be taken when stencil and depth tests fail.

properties.allTestsPassOperation: Holds the stencil test operation for when depth and stencil test pass. Default is StencilOperationArguments.Keep.
properties.faceMode: Holds the faces the arguments are applied to.
properties.depthTestFailureOperation: Holds the stencil test operation for when the stencil test passes, but depth test fails. Default is StencilOperationArguments.Keep.
properties.stencilTestFailureOperation: Holds the stencil test operation for when the stencil test fails. Default is StencilOperationArguments.Keep.

Shear.description: Provides a way to shear an Item.

properties.yFactor: The factor by which to shear the item's coordinate system along the y-axis. The factor by which to shear the item's coordinate system along the x-axis. Each point P is displaced by xFactor(P.y - origin.y)
properties.yAngle: The angle (in degrees) by which to shear the item's coordinate system along the y-axis. This is equivalent to setting yFactor to tan(yAngle).
properties.xFactor: The factor by which to shear the item's coordinate system along the x-axis. Each point P is displaced by xFactor(P.y - origin.y)
properties.xAngle: The angle (in degrees) by which to shear the item's coordinate system along the x-axis. This is equivalent to setting xFactor to tan(xAngle).

Qt.description: Provides a global object with useful enums and functions from Qt.

properties.inputMethod: It is the same as the InputMethod singleton.
properties.platform: The platform object provides info about the underlying platform.
properties.styleHints: The styleHints object provides platform-specific style hints and settings. See the QStyleHints documentation for further details.
properties.application: The application object provides access to global application state properties shared by many QML components.
properties.uiLanguage: The uiLanguage holds the name of the language to be used for user interface string translations. It is exposed in C++ as QJSEngine::uiLanguage property.

ControlStateStyle.description: Describes the style of a control in a given state.

properties.disabled: Style overrides applied when the control is disabled.
properties.checked: Style overrides applied when the control is checked.
properties.highlighted: Style overrides applied when the control is highlighted.
properties.focused: Style overrides applied when the control is focused.
properties.pressed: Style overrides applied when the control is pressed.
properties.hovered: Style overrides applied when the control is hovered.
properties.vertical: Style overrides applied when the control is vertical (for example, a vertical Slider or ScrollBar).

ScreenRayCaster.description: Performe ray casting test based on screen coordinates.

properties.position: Holds the length of the 3D ray.

properties.active: This property reflects the active status of the input panel. The keyboard should be made visible to the user when this property is true.
properties.externalLanguageSwitchEnabled: This property enables the external language switch mechanism. When this property is true, the virtual keyboard will not show the built-in language popup, but will emit the externalLanguageSwitch signal instead. The application can handle this signal and show a custom language selection dialog instead.

Value3DAxis.description: Manipulates an axis of a graph.

properties.scaleLabelsByCount: Whether the labels will automatically adjust their size based on the total amount of labels.
properties.titleOffset: The position of the axis title on the axis. The value must be between -1.0f and 1.0f
properties.labelFormat: The label format to be used for the labels on this axis.
properties.segmentCount: The number of segments on the axis. This indicates how many labels are drawn. The number of grid lines to be drawn is calculated with the following formula: segments * subsegments + 1. The preset default is 5. The value cannot be below 1.
properties.formatter: The axis formatter to be used. Any existing formatter is deleted when a new formatter is set.
properties.min: The minimum value on the axis. When setting this property, the maximum value is adjusted if necessary, so the range remains valid.
properties.type: The type of the axis.
properties.max: The maximum value on the axis. When setting this property, the minimum value is adjusted if necessary, so the range remains valid.
properties.reversed: If true, the axis will be rendered in reverse. That is, the positions of the minimum and maximum values are swapped when the graph is rendered. This property does not affect the actual minimum and maximum values of the axis.
properties.labelSize: The size of the label. The default for this value is 1.0.
properties.labelAutoAngle: The maximum angle the labels can autorotate when the camera angle changes. The angle can be between 0 and 90, inclusive. The default value is 0. If the value is 0, axis labels do not automatically rotate. If the value is greater than zero, labels attempt to orient themselves toward the camera, up to the specified angle.
properties.labelsVisible: Defines whether the axis labels are visible in the primary graph view.
properties.orientation: The orientation of the axis.
properties.subSegmentCount: The number of subsegments inside each segment on the axis. Grid lines are drawn between each subsegment, in addition to each segment. The preset default is 1. The value cannot be below 1.
properties.titleVisible: Defines whether the axis title is visible in the primary graph view.
properties.autoAdjustRange: Defines whether the axis will automatically adjust the range so that all data fits in it.
properties.title: The title for the axis.

properties.regularExpression: This property holds the regular expression used for validation.

AmbientTemperatureReading.description: The AmbientTemperatureReading element holds the most recent temperature reading.

properties.temperature: This property holds the ambient temperature in degree Celsius.

TextStyle.description: Defines the text style for a control's label.

properties.bottomPadding: The bottom padding around the text. If not set, falls back to padding.
properties.italic: Whether the text should be rendered in italic. The default value is false.
properties.rightPadding: The right padding around the text. If not set, falls back to padding.
properties.second: Grouped property for styling the second text element in controls that expose two separate text labels. Unset properties fall back to text itself.
properties.padding: The uniform padding around the text. Setting this provides a default value for leftPadding, rightPadding, topPadding, and bottomPadding. Each side can be overridden individually.
properties.topPadding: The top padding around the text. If not set, falls back to padding.
properties.color: The color of the text.
properties.bold: Whether the text should be rendered in bold. The default value is false.
properties.first: Grouped property for styling the first text element in controls that expose two separate text labels. Unset properties fall back to text itself.
properties.alignment: The alignment of the text within its available area.
properties.leftPadding: The left padding around the text. If not set, falls back to padding.
properties.pointSize: The point size of the text font.

TabBar.description: Allows the user to switch between different views or subtasks.

properties.contentHeight: This property holds the content height. It is used for calculating the total implicit height of the tab bar.
properties.TabBar.tabBar: This attached property holds the tab bar that manages this tab button.
properties.TabBar.position: This attached property holds the position of the tab bar.
properties.contentWidth: This property holds the content width. It is used for calculating the total implicit width of the tab bar.
properties.TabBar.index: This attached property holds the index of each tab button in the TabBar.
properties.position: This property holds the position of the tab bar.

Component3D.description: Provides the base type for creating Qt 3D components.

StateGroup.description: Provides built-in state support for non-Item types.

properties.transitions: This property holds a list of transitions defined by the state group.
properties.states: This property holds a list of states defined by the state group.

QtShellChrome.description: Provides default window manager functionality for use with the qt-shell extension.

properties.windowFlags: This property holds the window flags of the QtShellChrome. They will match the windowFlags property of the associated QtShellSurface, except when this is equal to Qt.Window. In this case, a set of default window flags will be used instead. The default window flags are Qt.Window, Qt.WindowMaximizeButtonHint, Qt.WindowMinimizeButtonHint and Qt.WindowCloseButtonHint.
properties.shellSurfaceItem: This property holds the shell surface item associated with this QtShellChrome. It will in turn manage the shellSurface of this item. The shellSurface of the item is expected to be of the type QtShellSurface.
properties.bottomLeftResizeHandle: This property holds the default bottom-left resize handle of the QtShellChrome. If set, a DragHandler will be installed on the resize handle which resizes the window by moving its bottom and left edges in equal amounts.
properties.frameMarginBottom: Sets the size of the bottom margin of the QtShellChrome which is reserved for window decorations. By default, this will equal the height of the bottomResizeHandle if it is set. Otherwise it will be 0.
properties.topLeftResizeHandle: This property holds the default top-left resize handle of the QtShellChrome. If set, a DragHandler will be installed on the resize handle which resizes the window by moving its top and left edges in equal amounts.
properties.hasDecorations: This property is true if the QtShellChrome's decorations should be visible, based on its window state and window flags.
properties.frameMarginRight: Sets the size of the right margin of the QtShellChrome which is reserved for window decorations. By default, this will equal the width of the rightResizeHandle if it is set. Otherwise it will be 0.
properties.leftResizeHandle: This property holds the default left resize handle of the QtShellChrome. If set, a DragHandler will be installed on the resize handle which resizes the window by moving its left edge.
properties.maximizedRect: This property holds the are of the WaylandOutput which is available to be filled by the window when it is in maximized state. By default, the window will fill the entire geometry of the WaylandOutput when it is maximized. Changing it can be useful for example when the compositor has other system UI which should not be obscured by maximized applications, such as a task bar.
properties.rightResizeHandle: This property holds the default right resize handle of the QtShellChrome. If set, a DragHandler will be installed on the resize handle which resizes the window by moving its right edge.
properties.topResizeHandle: This property holds the default top resize handle of the QtShellChrome. If set, a DragHandler will be installed on the resize handle which resizes the window by moving its top edge.
properties.windowState: This property holds the window state of the shell surface. It will be updated immediately when the window state is requested on the compositor-side, before this has been acknowledged by the client. Therefore, it may in brief periods differ from the shell surface's windowState property, which will be updated when the client has acknowledged the request.
properties.frameMarginTop: Sets the size of the top margin of the QtShellChrome which is reserved for window decorations. By default, this will equal the sum of the leftResizeHandle and the titleBar's heights, if they are set. Otherwise it will be 0.
properties.frameMarginLeft: Sets the size of the left margin of the QtShellChrome which is reserved for window decorations. By default, this will equal the width of the leftResizeHandle if it is set. Otherwise it will be 0.
properties.titleBar: This property holds the default title bar item of the QtShellChrome. If set, a DragHandler will be installed on the title bar which moves the window around on user interaction. In addition, the window will automatically be activated if the title bar is clicked.
properties.bottomRightResizeHandle: This property holds the default bottom-right resize handle of the QtShellChrome. If set, a DragHandler will be installed on the resize handle which resizes the window by moving its bottom and right edges in equal amounts.
properties.bottomResizeHandle: This property holds the default bottom resize handle of the QtShellChrome. If set, a DragHandler will be installed on the resize handle which resizes the window by moving its bottom edge.
properties.topRightResizeHandle: This property holds the default top-right resize handle of the QtShellChrome. If set, a DragHandler will be installed on the resize handle which resizes the window by moving its top and right edges in equal amounts.

properties.singleHighlightColor: The highlight color for a selected object. Used if selectionMode has the AbstractGraph3D.SelectionItem flag set.

View3D.description: Provides a viewport on which to render a 3D scene.

properties.renderStats: This property provides statistics about the rendering of a frame, such as fps, frameTime, renderTime, syncTime, and maxFrameTime.
properties.explicitTextureWidth: The width, in pixels, of the item's associated texture. Relevant when a fixed texture size is desired that does not depend on the item's size. This size has no effect on the geometry of the item (its size and placement within the scene), which means the texture's content will appear scaled up or down (and possibly stretched) onto the item's area.
properties.environment: This property specifies the SceneEnvironment used to render the scene.
properties.renderOverrides: Controls how Qt Quick 3D performs rendering.
properties.scene: Returns the root Node of the View3D's scene.
properties.effectiveTextureSize: This property exposes the size, in pixels, of the underlying color (and depth/stencil) buffers. It is provided for use on the GUI (main) thread, in QML bindings or JavaScript.
properties.explicitTextureHeight: The height, in pixels, of the item's associated texture. Relevant when a fixed texture size is desired that does not depend on the item's size. This size has no effect on the geometry of the item (its size and placement within the scene), which means the texture's content will appear scaled up or down (and possibly stretched) onto the item's area.
properties.importScene: This property defines the reference node of the scene to render to the viewport. The node does not have to be a child of the View3D. This referenced node becomes a sibling with child nodes of View3D, if there are any.
properties.renderMode: This property determines how the View3D is combined with the other parts of the Qt Quick scene.
properties.camera: This property specifies which Camera is used to render the scene. If this property is not set, then the first enabled camera in the scene will be used.
properties.renderFormat: This property determines the backing texture's format. Applicable only when the View3D is rendering to a texture, for example because the renderMode is View3D.Offscreen.
properties.extensions: This property contains a list of user extensions that should be used with this View3D.

properties.source: This property defines the item that is going to be filled with gradient. Source item gets rendered into an intermediate pixel buffer and the alpha values from the result are used to determine the gradient's pixels visibility in the display. The default value for source is undefined and in that case whole effect area is filled with gradient.
properties.end: This property defines the ending point where the color at gradient position of 1.0 is rendered. Colors at smaller position values are rendered linearly towards the start point. The point is given in pixels and the default value is Qt.point(0, height). Setting the default values for the start and end results in a full height linear gradient on the y-axis.
properties.start: This property defines the starting point where the color at gradient position of 0.0 is rendered. Colors at larger position values are rendered linearly towards the end point. The point is given in pixels and the default value is Qt.point(0, 0). Setting the default values for the start and end results in a full height linear gradient on the y-axis.
properties.gradient: A gradient is defined by two or more colors, which are blended seamlessly. The colors are specified as a set of GradientStop child items, each of which defines a position on the gradient from 0.0 to 1.0 and a color. The position of each GradientStop is defined by the position property, and the color is definded by the color property.
properties.cached: This property allows the effect output pixels to be cached in order to improve the rendering performance.

NoDraw.description: When a NoDraw node is present in a FrameGraph branch, this prevents the renderer from rendering any primitive.

properties.maximumFlickVelocity: This property holds the approximate maximum velocity that the user can flick the view in pixels/second.

properties.PathView.onPath: This attached property holds whether the item is currently on the path.

properties.cacheItemCount: This property holds the maximum number of items to cache off the path.

properties.movementDirection: This property determines the direction in which items move when setting the current index. The possible values are:

properties.dragMargin: This property holds the maximum distance from the path that initiates mouse dragging.
properties.currentItem: This property holds the current item in the view.
properties.model: This property holds the model providing data for the view.
properties.highlightItem: highlightItem holds the highlight item, which was created from the highlight component.
properties.offset: The offset specifies how far along the path the items are from their initial positions. This is a real number that ranges from 0 to the count of items in the model.
properties.interactive: A user cannot drag or flick a PathView that is not interactive.
