properties.sourceTimestamp: Sets the source timestamp for the value to write. If the source timestamp is invalid, it is ignored by the client and not sent to the server. If the server doesn't support writing timestamps, the write operation for this item will fail.
properties.serverTimestamp: Sets the server timestamp for the value to be written. If the server timestamp is invalid, it is ignored by the client and not sent to the server. If the server doesn't support writing timestamps, the write operation for this item will fail.
properties.attribute: Determines the attribute of the node to be written.

DepthTest.description: The DepthTest type tests the fragment shader's depth value against the depth of a sample being written to.

properties.depthFunction: Holds the current function used by depth test. The default is DepthTest.Never.

TechniqueFilter.description: A FrameGraphNode used to select used Techniques.

properties.matchAll: Holds the list of filterkeys used by the TechiqueFilter
properties.parameters: Holds the list of parameters used by the TechiqueFilter

XrSimpleHapticEffect.description: Allows setting controller haptics using amplitude, duration and frequency.

properties.duration: Defines the duration of the haptic effect in milliseconds.
properties.frequency: Defines the frequency of the haptic effect in Hz
properties.amplitude: Defines the amplitude of the effect's vibration. Acceptable values are from 0.0 to 1.0

TimelineAnimationNode.description: A blend tree source node that plays a timeline animation.

properties.currentFrame: This property holds the current frame of the animation.
properties.animation: This property holds the timeline animation to play.
properties.timeline: This property holds the timeline that the animation is played on.

properties.smoothShading: This property defines whether the height map is shown with smooth shading or with hard angles between the squares of the map.
properties.source: This property defines the URL of the height map image.
properties.extents: This property defines the extents of the height-field, that is the dimensions of a box large enough to always contain the geometry. The default value is (100, 100, 100) when the image is square.

HandwritingInputPanel.description: Provides a handwriting panel add-on for the virtual keyboard UI.

properties.inputPanel: A reference to the input panel instance.
properties.available: This property controls the availability status of the handwriting input method.
properties.active: This property controls the active status of the handwriting input method.

properties.floorLevel: The floor level for the bar graph in Y-axis data coordinates.
properties.primarySeries: The primary series of the graph. It is used to determine the row and column axis labels when the labels are not explicitly set to the axes.
properties.selectedSeries: The selected series or null. If selectionMode has the SelectionMultiSeries flag set, this property holds the series that owns the selected bar.
properties.barSeriesMargin: Margin between series columns in X and Z dimensions. Preset to (0.0, 0.0) by default. Sensible values are on the range [0,1).
properties.barSpacing: Bar spacing in X and Z dimensions.
properties.barThickness: The bar thickness ratio between the X and Z dimensions. The value 1.0 means that the bars are as wide as they are deep, whereas 0.5 makes them twice as deep as they are wide.
properties.barSpacingRelative: Whether spacing is absolute or relative to bar thickness.
properties.seriesList: The series of the graph. By default, this property contains an empty list. To set the series, either use the addSeries() function or define them as children of the graph.
properties.multiSeriesUniform: Defines whether bars are to be scaled with proportions set to a single series bar even if there are multiple series displayed. If set to true, bar spacing will be correctly applied only to the X-axis. Preset to false by default.

DiffuseSpecularMaterial.description: The DiffuseSpecularMaterial class provides a default implementation of the phong lighting effect.

properties.alphaBlending: Indicates if the alpha information coming from the diffuse property will be taken into account during rendering. Defaults to false.
properties.diffuse: Holds the diffuse color of the material that is emitted for rough surface reflections with the lights. This can be either a plain color value or a texture.
properties.specular: Holds the specular color of the material that is emitted for shiny surface reflections with the lights. This can be either a plain color value or a texture.
properties.ambient: Holds the ambient color that is emitted by an object without any other light source.
properties.textureScale: Holds the current texture scale. It is applied as a multiplier to texture coordinates at render time. Defaults to 1.0.
properties.shininess: Holds the shininess exponent. Higher values of shininess result in a smaller and brighter highlight.
properties.normal: Holds the current normal map texture of the material. This can only be a texture, otherwise it is ignored. By default this map is not set.

ItemSelectionModel.description: Instantiates a QItemSelectionModel to be used in conjunction with a QAbstractItemModel and any view supporting it.

properties.selectedIndexes: Contains the list of all the indexes (QModelIndex instances) in the selection model.
properties.selection: Holds the selection ranges stored in the selection model.
properties.hasSelection: It will trigger property binding updates every time selectionChanged() is emitted, even though its value hasn't changed.
properties.currentIndex: Use setCurrentIndex() to set its value.
properties.model: This property's value must match the view's model.

LevelOfDetailLoader.description: An entity loader that changes depending on distance to camera or screen size.

properties.sources: The list of sources (array of strings) to load from.

KeyPanel.description: A base type of the styled keys.

properties.soundEffect: Sets the sound effect to be played on key press.
properties.control: Provides access to properties in BaseKey.

Tumbler.description: Spinnable wheel of items that can be selected.

properties.Tumbler.displacement: This attached property holds a value from -visibleItemCount / 2 to visibleItemCount / 2, which represents how far away this item is from being the current item, with 0 being completely current.
properties.flickDeceleration: This property holds the rate at which a flick will decelerate: the higher the number, the faster it slows down when the user stops flicking via touch. For example, 0.0001 is nearly "frictionless", and 10000 feels quite "sticky".
properties.model: This property holds the model that provides data for this tumbler.
properties.count: This property holds the number of items in the model.
properties.moving: This property describes whether the tumbler is currently moving, due to the user either dragging or flicking it.
properties.delegate: This property holds the delegate used to display each item.
properties.currentItem: This property holds the item at the current index.
properties.visibleItemCount: This property holds the number of items visible in the tumbler. It must be an odd number, as the current item is always vertically centered.
properties.currentIndex: This property holds the index of the current item.
properties.Tumbler.tumbler: This attached property holds the tumbler. The property can be attached to a tumbler delegate. The value is null if the item is not a tumbler delegate.
properties.wrap: This property determines whether or not the tumbler wraps around when it reaches the top or bottom.

Gyroscope.description: The Gyroscope element reports on rotational acceleration around the X, Y and Z axes.

TimeoutTransition.description: The TimeoutTransition type provides a transition based on a timer.

RectangularShadow.description: Creates smoothed rectangle, suitable for example for shadow and glow effects.

properties.spread: This property defines how much the shadow is spread (extended) in pixels. This spread is appended to the shadow size, relative to the RectangularShadow item size.
properties.topRightRadius: This property holds the radius used to draw the top right corner.
properties.antialiasing: Used to decide if the shadow should use antialiasing or not. When this is true, a single pixel antialiasing is used even when the blur is 0.
properties.bottomRightRadius: This property holds the radius used to draw the bottom right corner.
properties.offset: This property defines the position offset that is used for the shadow. This offset is appended to the shadow position, relative to the RectangularShadow item position.
properties.radius: This property defines the corner radius that is used to draw a shadow with rounded corners.
properties.color: This property defines the RGBA color value that is used for the shadow.
properties.material: This property contains the ShaderEffect item of the shadow. You can use this property to visualize the reach of the shadow, because the effect item often has different position and size than the RectangularShadow item, due to blur, offset and spread.
properties.cached: This property allows the effect output pixels to be cached in order to improve the rendering performance.
properties.topLeftRadius: This property holds the radius used to draw the top left corner.
properties.blur: This property defines how many pixels outside the item area are reached by the shadow.
properties.bottomLeftRadius: This property holds the radius used to draw the bottom left corner.

Canvas2DContext.description: Provides a 2D context for drawing on a Canvas2D item.

properties.canvas: Holds the canvas item that the context paints on.
properties.globalCompositeOperation: Holds the current composition operation. This mode is applied to all painting operations. Allowed operations are:
properties.textWrapMode: Holds the current text wrap mode, so how the text is wrapped to multiple lines. The possible values are:
properties.globalBrightness: Holds the current brightness value applied to rendering operations. This brightess is applied to all rendered shapes. A value of 0 will cause painting to be completely black. Value can also be bigger than 1.0, to increase the brightness. By default, brightness is 1.0.
properties.fillStyle: Holds the current style used for filling shapes. The default fill style is solid black ('#000000'). The style can be either a string containing a CSS color, QML color, or a canvas brush object. Invalid values are ignored. This property accepts several color syntaxes:
properties.strokeStyle: Holds the current color or style to use for the lines around shapes, The style can be either a string containing a CSS color, QML color, or a canvas brush object. Invalid values are ignored.
properties.font: Holds the current font settings.
properties.lineCap: Holds the current line cap style. The possible line cap styles are:
properties.textAntialias: Holds the current text antialias amount. The value is a multiplier to normal antialiasing, meaning that 0.0 disables antialiasing and 2.0 doubles it. The default value is 1.0.
properties.windingEnforce: Holds the current winding enforcing enabling status. Setting this to false disables enforcing of path winding to match what has been set into setPathWinding(). Disabling allows e.g. creating holes into paths by adding the points in clock wise order. Disabling can also increase the performance. The default value is true.
properties.globalAlpha: Holds the current alpha (transparency) value applied to rendering operations. This alpha value is applied to all rendered shapes. Already transparent paths will get proportionally more transparent as well. Alpha should be between 0.0 (fully transparent) and 1.0 (fully opaque). By default alpha is 1.0.
properties.lineWidth: Holds the current line width. The default line width is 1.0. When antialiasing is enabled, the line widths under a single pixel automatically fade the opacity, creating a smooth output.
properties.fillRule: Holds the current fill rule used for filling shapes. This value is applied to all fill() calls after the rule has been set. The default fill rule is "nonzero"
properties.lineJoin: Holds the current line join style. A join exists at any point in a subpath shared by two consecutive lines. When a subpath is closed, then a join also exists at its first point (equivalent to its last point) connecting the first and last lines in the subpath.
properties.antialias: Holds the current antialias amount. More antialias means smoother painting. This only affects fill and stroke painting, not images or texts. The default value is 1.0 and the maximum value is 10.0.
properties.miterLimit: Holds the current miter limit length. Miter limit controls when a sharp corner is beveled. When the corner length would become longer than this limit, a "bevel" lineJoin will be applied between the lines instead. This only has effect with the "miter" line join. The default limit is 10.0.
properties.globalContrast: Holds the current contrast value applied to rendering operations. This contrast is applied to all rendered shapes. A value of 0 will cause painting to be completely gray (0.5, 0.5, 0.5). Value can also be bigger than 1.0, to increase the contrast. By default, contrast is 1.0.
properties.textBaseline: Holds the current baseline alignment settings. The possible values are:
properties.textAlign: Holds the current text alignment settings. The possible values are:
properties.direction: Holds the current direction used to draw text. The possible values are:
properties.globalSaturation: Holds the current saturation value applied to rendering operations. This saturations is applied to all rendered shapes. A value of 0 will disable saturation and cause painting to be completely grayscale. Value can also be bigger than 1.0, to increase the saturation. By default, saturation is 1.0.
properties.highQualityStroking: Holds the current high quality stroking enabling status. Setting this to true gives a more correct rendering in some less common cases where stroking overlaps and doesn't have full opacity. Enabling it results into higher rendering cost. The default value is false.
properties.textLineHeight: Holds the current text line height adjustment amount in pixels. The default line height is 0.

ParticleSceneShape3D.description: Offers particle shape from a scene for emitters and affectors.

properties.excludedNodes: This property holds the list of nodes that are excluded when building the shape. Model is excluded from the shape if it is one of the nodes or their child node.
properties.scene: This property holds the root node of the scene. The scene shape is dynamically calculated based on the child models of the scene. If the scene changes, the shape is recalculated. If a model is not visible in the scene, it won't be included in the shape. Only the node visibility is checked by the implementation. If the material is fully transparent or the node gets filtered out, the shape will still contain those nodes unless they are manyally excluded.
properties.sceneCenter: This property holds the center point where the shape is calculated.
properties.sceneExtents: This property holds the extents for which the shape is calculated. The extents are added to the scene center and any polygon outside this volume are left out of the shape. If this value is empty, all polygons are included.
properties.shapeResolution: This property holds the resolution of the shape. The higher the value the more accurately the shape resembles individual models.
properties.geometry: This property holds the geometry of the generated shape. It can be used to render the shape to visualize it.

RangeSlider.description: Used to select a range of values by sliding two handles along a track.

properties.handlesCrossed: This property holds whether the handles have crossed each other.
properties.stepSize: This property holds the step size. The default value is 0.0.
properties.snapMode: This property holds the snap mode.
properties.horizontal: This property holds whether the slider is horizontal.
properties.effectiveFirstValue: This property holds the value of the handle that was originally created as the "first" handle, regardless of whether handles have crossed.
properties.orientation: This property holds the orientation.
properties.touchDragThreshold: This property holds the threshold (in logical pixels) at which a touch drag event will be initiated. The mouse drag threshold won't be affected. The default value is Application.styleHints.startDragDistance.
properties.crossingEnabled: This property determines whether the slider handles can cross each other.
properties.to: This property holds the end value for the range. The default value is 1.0.
properties.vertical: This property holds whether the slider is vertical.
properties.live: This property holds whether the slider provides live updates for the first.value and second.value properties while the respective handles are dragged.
properties.effectiveSecondValue: This property holds the value of the handle in the visual "second" position (rightmost in horizontal, topmost in vertical orientation).
properties.from: This property holds the starting value for the range. The default value is 0.0.

Gravity3D.description: Accelerates particles to a vector of the specified magnitude in the specified direction.

properties.direction: This property defines the direction the gravity will affect toward. Values will be automatically normalized to a unit vector.
properties.magnitude: This property defines the magnitude in position change per second. Negative magnitude accelerates the opposite way from the direction.

DropArea.description: For specifying drag and drop handling in an area.

properties.drag.source: This property holds the source of a drag.
properties.keys: This property holds a list of drag keys a DropArea will accept.
properties.containsDrag: This property identifies whether the DropArea currently contains any dragged items.

ItemModelBarDataProxy.description: Proxy class for presenting data in item models with Bars3D.

properties.useModelCategories: When set to true, the mapping ignores row and column roles and categories, and uses the rows and columns from the model instead. Row and column headers are used for row and column labels. Defaults to false.
properties.valueRole: The item model role to map into bar value.
properties.columnRoleReplace: This property defines the replace content to be used in conjunction with columnRolePattern. Defaults to empty string. For more information on how the search and replace using regular expressions works, see QString::replace(const QRegularExpression &rx, const QString &after) function documentation.
properties.columnRolePattern: When set, a search and replace is done on the value mapped by column role before it is used as a column category. This property specifies the regular expression to find the portion of the mapped value to replace and columnRoleReplace property contains the replacement string. This is useful for example in parsing row and column categories from a single timestamp field in the item model.
properties.autoRowCategories: When set to true, the mapping ignores any explicitly set row categories and overwrites them with automatically generated ones whenever the data from the model is resolved. Defaults to true.
properties.columnCategories: The column categories of the mapping. Only items with column role values that are found in this list are included when the data is resolved. The columns are ordered in the same order as they are in this list.
properties.rowCategories: The row categories of the mapping. Only items with row role values that are found in this list are included when the data is resolved. The rows are ordered in the same order as they are in this list.
properties.autoColumnCategories: When set to true, the mapping ignores any explicitly set column categories and overwrites them with automatically generated ones whenever the data from model is resolved. Defaults to true.
properties.rotationRolePattern: When set, a search and replace is done on the value mapped by rotation role before it is used as a bar rotation angle. This property specifies the regular expression to find the portion of the mapped value to replace and rotationRoleReplace property contains the replacement string.
properties.rotationRoleReplace: This property defines the replace content to be used in conjunction with rotationRolePattern. Defaults to empty string. For more information on how the search and replace using regular expressions works, see QString::replace(const QRegularExpression &rx, const QString &after) function documentation.
properties.rowRole: The item model role to map into row category.
properties.rotationRole: The item model role to map into bar rotation angle.
properties.rowRolePattern: When set, a search and replace is done on the value mapped by row role before it is used as a row category. This property specifies the regular expression to find the portion of the mapped value to replace and rowRoleReplace property contains the replacement string. This is useful for example in parsing row and column categories from a single timestamp field in the item model.
properties.rowRoleReplace: This property defines the replace content to be used in conjunction with rowRolePattern. Defaults to empty string. For more information on how the search and replace using regular expressions works, see QString::replace(const QRegularExpression &rx, const QString &after) function documentation.
properties.columnRole: The item model role to map into column category.
properties.multiMatchBehavior: Defines how multiple matches for each row/column combination are handled. Defaults to ItemModelBarDataProxy.MMBLast. The chosen behavior affects both bar value and rotation.
properties.valueRoleReplace: This property defines the replace content to be used in conjunction with valueRolePattern. Defaults to empty string. For more information on how the search and replace using regular expressions works, see QString::replace(const QRegularExpression &rx, const QString &after) function documentation.
properties.valueRolePattern: When set, a search and replace is done on the value mapped by value role before it is used as a bar value. This property specifies the regular expression to find the portion of the mapped value to replace and valueRoleReplace property contains the replacement string.

properties.saturation: The strength of all the colors in the scene. The range is [-1...1], where -1 is fully desaturated, 0 is unmodified, and 1 is heavily oversaturated. The default value is 0.
properties.blueStrength: A multiplication factor for the blue color channel. The range is [0...2]. The default value is 1.
properties.redStrength: A multiplication factor for the red color channel. The range is [0...2]. The default value is 1.
properties.greenStrength: A multiplication factor for the green color channel. The range is [0...2]. The default value is 1.5.

CubeMapTexture.description: Defines a cube map texture for use in 3D scenes.

properties.optimizationHints: Whether the default or static mode is used for rendering optimization.
properties.currentFps: When FPS measuring is enabled, the results for the last second are stored in this read-only property. It takes at least a second before this value updates after measuring is activated.
properties.shadowsSupported: This read-only property indicates whether shadows are supported with the current configuration. OpenGL ES2 configurations do not support shadows.
properties.aspectRatio: The ratio of the graph scaling between the longest axis on the horizontal plane and the y-axis. Defaults to 2.0.
properties.horizontalAspectRatio: The ratio of the graph scaling between the x-axis and z-axis. The value of 0.0 indicates automatic scaling according to axis ranges. Defaults to 0.0.
properties.scene: The Scene3D pointer that can be used to manipulate the scene and access the scene elements, such as the active camera.
properties.selectedElement: The element selected in the graph.
properties.shadowQuality: The quality of shadows. One of the QAbstract3DGraph::ShadowQuality enum values.
properties.customItemList: The list of Custom3DItem items added to the graph. The graph takes ownership of the added items.
properties.locale: Sets the locale used for formatting various numeric labels. Defaults to the "C" locale.
properties.margin: The absolute value used for the space left between the edge of the plottable graph area and the edge of the graph background.
properties.measureFps: If true, the rendering is done continuously instead of on demand, and the value of the currentFps property is updated. Defaults to false.
properties.reflectivity: Sets floor reflectivity. Larger numbers make the floor more reflective. The valid range is [0...1]. Defaults to 0.5.
properties.orthoProjection: If true, orthographic projection will be used for displaying the graph. Defaults to false.
properties.reflection: Sets floor reflections on or off. Defaults to false.
properties.selectionMode: The active selection mode in the visualization. One of the QAbstract3DGraph::SelectionFlag enum values.
properties.polar: If true, the horizontal axes are changed into polar axes. The x-axis becomes the angular axis and the z-axis becomes the radial axis. Polar mode is not available for bar graphs.
properties.inputHandler: The active input handler used in the graph. You can disable default input handlers by setting this property to null.
properties.queriedGraphPosition: This read-only property contains the latest graph position values along each axis queried using Scene3D::graphPositionQuery. The values are normalized to range [-1, 1]. If the queried position was outside the graph bounds, the values will not reflect the real position, but will instead be some undefined position outside the range [-1, 1]. The value will be undefined until a query is made.
properties.radialLabelOffset: This property specifies the normalized horizontal offset for the axis labels of the radial polar axis. The value 0.0 indicates that the labels should be drawn next to the 0-angle angular axis grid line. The value 1.0 indicates that the labels are drawn in their usual place at the edge of the graph background. This property is ignored if the polar property value is false. Defaults to 1.0.
properties.theme: The active theme of the graph.
properties.msaaSamples: The number of samples used in multisample antialiasing when renderingMode is RenderIndirect. When renderingMode is RenderDirectToBackground or RenderDirectToBackground_NoClear, this property value is read-only and returns the number of samples specified by the window surface format. Defaults to 4.

XYSeriesAnimation.description: An animation type which signifies the animation for points.

properties.animating: Holds the animation state. One of GraphAnimation::AnimationState.

AbstractTextureImage.description: Encapsulates the necessary information to create an OpenGL texture image.

properties.face: Holds the cube map face of the texture image.
properties.mipLevel: Holds the mipmap level of the texture image.
properties.layer: Holds the layer of the texture image.

Displace.description: Moves the pixels of the source item according to the given displacement map.

properties.displacementSource: This property defines the item that is going to be used as the displacement map. The displacementSource item gets rendered into the intermediate pixel buffer. The red and green component values from the result determine the displacement of the pixels from the source item.
properties.displacement: This property defines the scale for the displacement. The bigger scale, the bigger the displacement of the pixels. The value set to 0.0 causes no displacement.
properties.source: This property defines the source item for the pixels that are going to be displaced according to the data from displacementSource.
properties.cached: This property allows the effect output pixels to be cached in order to improve the rendering performance.

ParticleExtruder (Uncreatable).description: For specifying an area for affectors and emitters.

properties.renderStates: Holds the render states used by the render pass.
properties.shaderProgram: Holds the shader program to be used for this render pass.
properties.filterKeys: Holds the filter keys enabling the use of this render pass.
properties.parameters: Holds the shader parameter values used by the render pass.

properties.autoRepeat: This property holds whether the shortcut can auto repeat.
properties.nativeText: This property provides the shortcut's key sequence as a platform specific string. This means that it will be shown translated, and on macOS it will resemble a key sequence from the menu bar. It is best to display this text to the user (for example, on a tooltip).
properties.portableText: This property provides the shortcut's key sequence as a string in a "portable" format, suitable for reading and writing to a file. In many cases, it will look similar to the native text on Windows and X11.
properties.sequence: This property holds the shortcut's key sequence. The key sequence can be set to one of the standard keyboard shortcuts, or it can be described with a string containing a sequence of up to four key presses that are needed to activate the shortcut.
properties.enabled: This property holds whether the shortcut is enabled.
properties.sequences: This property holds multiple key sequences for the shortcut. The key sequences can be set to one of the standard keyboard shortcuts, or they can be described with strings containing sequences of up to four key presses that are needed to activate the shortcut.
properties.context: This property holds the shortcut context.

Texture.description: Defines a texture for use in 3D scenes.

properties.magFilter: This property determines how the texture is sampled when it is "magnified", i.e. a texel covers more than one pixel in screen space.
properties.tilingModeVertical: This property controls how the texture is mapped when the V scaling value is greater than 1.
properties.minFilter: This property determines how the texture is sampled when it is "minimized", i.e. a texel covers less than one pixel in screen space.
properties.positionU: This property offsets the U coordinate mapping from left to right.
properties.pivotV: This property sets the pivot V position which is used when applying a rotationUV.
properties.generateMipmaps: This property determines if mipmaps are generated for textures that do not provide mipmap levels themselves. Using mipmaps along with mip filtering gives better visual quality when viewing textures at a distance compared rendering without them, but it may come at a performance cost (both when initializing the image and during rendering).
properties.flipU: This property sets the use of the horizontally flipped texture coordinates.
properties.positionV: This property offsets the V coordinate mapping from bottom to top.
properties.indexUV: This property sets the UV coordinate index used by this texture. Since QtQuick3D supports 2 UV sets(0 or 1) for now, the value will be saturated to the range.
properties.source: This property holds the location of an image or texture file containing the data used by the texture.
properties.mipFilter: This property determines how the texture mipmaps are sampled when a texel covers less than one pixel.
properties.tilingModeDepth: This property controls how the texture is mapped when the Z scaling value is greater than 1.
properties.textureData: This property holds a reference to a TextureData component which defines the contents and properties of raw texture data.
properties.sourceItem: This property defines a Item to be used as the source of the texture. Using this property allows any 2D Qt Quick content to be used as a texture source by rendering that item as an offscreen layer.
properties.pivotU: This property sets the pivot U position which is used when applying a rotationUV.
properties.scaleU: This property defines how to scale the U texture coordinate when mapping to a mesh's UV coordinates.
properties.mappingMode: This property defines which method of mapping to use when sampling this texture.
properties.scaleV: This property defines how to scale the V texture coordinate when mapping to a mesh's UV coordinates.
properties.flipV: This property sets the use of the vertically flipped texture coordinates.
properties.autoOrientation: This property determines if a texture transformation, such as flipping the V texture coordinate, is applied automatically for textures where this is typically relevant.
properties.textureProvider: This property holds the RenderExtension that will provide the QRhiTexture that will be used by this item.
properties.rotationUV: This property rotates the texture around the pivot point. This is defined using euler angles and for a positive value rotation is clockwise.
properties.tilingModeHorizontal: Controls how the texture is mapped when the U scaling value is greater than 1.

properties.to: This property holds the end value for the animation.
properties.from: This property holds the starting value for the animation.

PickEvent.description: PickEvent holds information when an object is picked. This is received as a parameter in most of the QObjectPicker component signals when picking succeeds.

properties.modifiers: Specifies state of the mouse buttons for the event
properties.position: Specifies the mouse position with respect to the render area (window or quick item)
properties.localIntersection: Specifies the coordinates of the hit in the local coordinate system of the picked entity
properties.button: Specifies mouse button that caused the event
properties.entity: The entity that the picked geometry belongs to.
properties.viewport: The viewport in which this event originated. A null value means the event originated from a frame graph branch without a Viewport. If a frame graph branch has a Viewport inside a Viewport the property will contain the leaf viewport.
properties.worldIntersection: Specifies the coordinates of the hit in world coordinate system
properties.distance: Specifies the distance of the hit to the camera
properties.accepted: Specifies if event has been accepted
properties.buttons: Specifies state of the mouse buttons for the event

XrSpatialAnchorListModel.description: Provides a model containing spatial anchors.

properties.identifierFilter: Holds the list of identifiers for filtering spatial anchors.
properties.filterMode: Specifies the filter mode for spatial anchors.
properties.classificationStringFilter: Holds the classification strings used for filtering spatial anchors.
properties.classificationFilter: Holds the classification flag used for filtering spatial anchors.

Status.description: Status code of an OPC UA function.

properties.isGood: Returns whether the result status is a success.
properties.status: Returns the exact status code. This allows to handle the status specifically.
properties.Status: The names of this enumeration are matching the names from the standard, but the values are different.
properties.isBad: Returns whether the result status is a failure.

StyleKitDebug.description: Traces how style properties are resolved for a control.

properties.control: The id of the Control or StyleReader to trace.
properties.filter: A regular expression used to filter the debug output. Only lines matching the pattern are printed. By default, all output is shown.

ControlStyle.description: Defines the style for a control in the normal state.

properties.variations: A list of type variations for this control type.

ClipAnimator.description: ClipAnimator is a component providing simple animation playback capabilities.

properties.clip: This property holds the animation clip which contains the key frame data to be played back. The key frame data can be specified in either an AnimationClip or AnimationClipLoader.

AbstractSkeleton.description: A skeleton contains the joints for a skinned mesh.

Camera3D.description: Representation of a camera in 3D space.

properties.maxZoomLevel: Sets the maximum allowed camera zoom level. If the new maximum level is lower than the existing minimum level, the minimum level is adjusted to the new maximum as well. If the current zoomLevel is outside the new bounds, it is adjusted as well. Defaults to 500.0f.
properties.wrapYRotation: The behavior of the minimum and maximum limits in the Y-rotation. By default, the Y-rotation is limited between the minimum and maximum values without any wrapping.
properties.zoomLevel: The camera zoom level in percentage. The default value of 100.0 means there is no zoom in or out set in the camera. The value is limited by the minZoomLevel and maxZoomLevel properties.
properties.yRotation: The Y-rotation angle of the camera around the target point in degrees starting from the current base position.
properties.target: The camera target as a vector3d. Defaults to vector3d(0.0, 0.0, 0.0).
properties.wrapXRotation: The behavior of the minimum and maximum limits in the X-rotation. By default, the X-rotation wraps from minimum value to maximum and from maximum to minimum.
properties.minZoomLevel: Sets the minimum allowed camera zoom level. If the new minimum level is higher than the existing maximum level, the maximum level is adjusted to the new minimum as well. If the current zoomLevel is outside the new bounds, it is adjusted as well. The minZoomLevel cannot be set below 1.0. Defaults to 10.0.
properties.xRotation: The X-rotation angle of the camera around the target point in degrees starting from the current base position.
properties.cameraPreset: The currently active camera preset, which is one of Camera3D.CameraPreset. If no preset is active, the value is Camera3D.CameraPresetNone.

BorderStyle.description: Defines the border style for a delegate.

properties.color: The color of the border. The default value is transparent.
properties.width: The width of the border in pixels.

Parameter.description: Provides storage for a name and value pair. This maps to a shader uniform.

properties.value: Specifies the value of the parameter
properties.name: Specifies the name of the parameter

Obsolete Members for Gravity.description: The following members of QML type Gravity are deprecated. They are provided to keep old source code working. We strongly advise against using them in new code.

properties.acceleration: This property is deprecated. We strongly advise against using it in new code.

NormalDiffuseMapAlphaMaterial.description: The NormalDiffuseMapAlphaMaterial provides a specialization of NormalDiffuseMapMaterial with alpha coverage and a depth test performed in the rendering pass.

properties.diffuse: Holds the current diffuse map texture.
properties.textureScale: Holds the current texture scale. It is applied as a multiplier to texture coordinates at render time. Defaults to 1.0.
properties.normal: Holds the current normal map texture.

TrailEmitter3D.description: Emitter for logical particles from other particles.

properties.follow: This property defines the logical particle which this emitter follows. When the TrailEmitter3D emits particles, center position of those particles will become from the Particle3D the emitter follows.

HorizontalHeaderView.description: Provides a horizontal header view to accompany a TableView.

properties.model: This property holds the model providing data for the horizontal header view.
properties.movableColumns: This property allows the user to move columns in the view. The default value is false.
properties.syncView: This property holds the TableView to synchronize with.
properties.textRole: This property holds the model role used to display text in each header cell.

StyleVariation.description: Defines alternative styling for specific controls.

properties.StyleVariation.controlType: This property identifies the control type of the item it is attached to.
properties.name: The name of this variation.
properties.StyleVariation.variations: This property holds the list of instance variations to activate for a Control, and its descendant controls.

SurfaceDataProxy.description: The data proxy for a 3D surface graph.

properties.columnCount: The number of columns in the data array.
properties.series: The series this proxy is attached to.
properties.rowCount: The number of rows in the data array.

Rectangle.description: Paints a filled rectangle with an optional border.

properties.bottomRightRadius: This property holds the radius used to draw the bottom right corner.
properties.gradient: The gradient to use to fill the rectangle.
properties.bottomLeftRadius: This property holds the radius used to draw the bottom left corner.
properties.topRightRadius: This property holds the radius used to draw the top right corner.
properties.radius: This property holds the corner radius used to draw a rounded rectangle.
properties.topLeftRadius: This property holds the radius used to draw the top left corner.
properties.color: This property holds the color used to fill the rectangle.
properties.antialiasing: Used to decide if the Rectangle should use antialiasing or not. Antialiasing provides information on the performance implications of this property.

Margins.description: Defines margins between the edge of the chart rectangle and the plot area.

matrix4x4 QML Value Type.description: A matrix4x4 type is a 4-row and 4-column matrix.

PointerDeviceHandler.description: Abstract handler for pointer events with device-specific constraints.

properties.parent: The Item which is the scope of the handler; the Item in which it was declared. The handler will handle events on behalf of this Item, which means a pointer event is relevant if at least one of its eventPoints occurs within the Item's interior. Initially target() is the same, but it can be reassigned.
properties.grabPermissions: This property specifies the permissions when this handler's logic decides to take over the exclusive grab, or when it is asked to approve grab takeover or cancellation by another handler.
properties.target: The Item which this handler will manipulate.
properties.acceptedButtons: The mouse buttons which can activate this Pointer Handler.
properties.dragThreshold: The distance in pixels that the user must drag an eventPoint in order to have it treated as a drag gesture.
properties.acceptedDevices: The types of pointing devices that can activate this Pointer Handler.
properties.margin: The margin beyond the bounds of the parent item within which an eventPoint can activate this handler. For example, on a PinchHandler where the target is also the parent, it's useful to set this to a distance at least half the width of a typical user's finger, so that if the parent has been scaled down to a very small size, the pinch gesture is still possible. Or, if a TapHandler-based button is placed near the screen edge, it can be used to comply with Fitts's Law: react to mouse clicks at the screen edge even though the button is visually spaced away from the edge by a few pixels.
properties.acceptedPointerTypes: The types of pointing instruments (finger, stylus, eraser, etc.) that can activate this Pointer Handler.
properties.active: This holds true whenever this Input Handler has taken sole responsibility for handing one or more eventPoints, by successfully taking an exclusive grab of those points. This means that it is keeping its properties up-to-date according to the movements of those eventPoints and actively manipulating its target (if any).
properties.acceptedModifiers: If this property is set, it will require the given keyboard modifiers to be pressed in order to react to pointer events, and otherwise ignore them.
properties.enabled: If a PointerHandler is disabled, it will reject all events and no signals will be emitted.
properties.cursorShape: This property holds the cursor shape that will appear whenever the mouse is hovering over the parent item while active is true.

ImageStyle.description: Defines the image style for a delegate.

properties.color: A color overlay applied to the image. This is typically used to tint monochrome icons to match the style's color scheme.
properties.fillMode: How the image should be scaled or tiled within the delegate. The value is one of the Image.fillMode enum values.
properties.source: The URL of the image to display inside the delegate.

HXYModelMapper.description: A horizontal model mapper for XYSeries.

properties.columnCount: The number of columns of the model that are mapped as the data for series. The default value is -1 (the number is limited by the number of columns in the model).
properties.xRow: The row of the model that contains the x-coordinates of the data points. The default value is -1 (invalid mapping).
properties.firstColumn: The column of the model that contains the data for the first point of the series. The default value is 0.
properties.model: The data model that is used by the mapper. You need to implement the model and expose it to QML.
properties.series: The series that is used by the mapper. All the data in the series is discarded when it is set to the mapper. When a new series is specified, the old series is disconnected (but it preserves its data).
properties.yRow: The row of the model that contains the y-coordinates of the data points.

RadialBlur.description: Applies directional blur in a circular direction around the items center point.

properties.angle: This property defines the direction for the blur and at the same time the level of blurring. The larger the angle, the more the result becomes blurred. The quality of the blur depends on samples property. If angle value is large, more samples are needed to keep the visual quality at high level.
properties.cached: This property allows the effect output pixels to be cached in order to improve the rendering performance.
properties.horizontalOffset: These properties define the offset in pixels for the perceived center point of the rotation.
properties.transparentBorder: This property defines the blur behavior near the edges of the item, where the pixel blurring is affected by the pixels outside the source edges.
properties.samples: This property defines how many samples are taken per pixel when blur calculation is done. Larger value produces better quality, but is slower to render.
properties.verticalOffset: These properties define the offset in pixels for the perceived center point of the rotation.
properties.source: This property defines the source item that is going to be blurred.

Custom3DLabel.description: Adds a custom label to a graph.

properties.textColor: The color for the label text. Also affects label border, if enabled. Defaults to "white".
properties.backgroundColor: The color for the label background, if enabled. Defaults to "gray".
properties.backgroundEnabled: Defines whether the label background is enabled. If set to false, backgroundColor has no effect. Defaults to true.
properties.borderEnabled: Defines whether label borders are enabled. Defaults to true.
properties.facingCamera: Defines whether the label will always face the camera. Defaults to false. If set to true, rotation has no effect.
properties.text: The text for the label. Rich text is not supported.
properties.font: The font to be used for the label. Defaults to Font {family: "Arial"; pointSize: 20}. Special formatting (for example, outlined) is not supported.

Abstract3DSeries (Uncreatable).description: A base type for all 3D data series.

properties.lightingMode: The lighting mode of the items in the series. The default value is QAbstract3DSeries::LightingMode::Shaded
properties.multiHighlightGradient: The multiple item highlight gradient of the series.
properties.name: The series name. It can be used in item label format with the tag @seriesName.
properties.visible: The visibility of the series. If false, the series is not rendered.
properties.singleHighlightGradient: The single item highlight gradient of the series.
properties.itemLabelVisible: If true, item labels are drawn as floating labels in the graph. Otherwise, item labels are not drawn. To show the item label in an external control, this property is set to false. Defaults to true.
properties.baseGradient: The base gradient of the series.
properties.mesh: The mesh of the items in the series, or the selection pointer in case of Surface3DSeries. If the mesh is Abstract3DSeries.Mesh.UserDefined, then the userDefinedMesh property must also be set for items to render properly. The default value depends on the graph type.
properties.type: The type of the series. One of the QAbstract3DSeries::SeriesType values.
properties.userDefinedMesh: The filename for a user defined custom mesh for objects that is used when mesh is Abstract3DSeries.Mesh.UserDefined.
properties.singleHighlightColor: The single item highlight color of the series.
properties.meshSmooth: If true, smooth versions of predefined meshes set via the mesh property are used. This property does not affect custom meshes used when the mesh is set to Abstract3DSeries.Mesh.UserDefined. Defaults to false.
properties.colorStyle: The color style for the series.
properties.multiHighlightColor: The multiple item highlight color of the series.
properties.itemLabel: The formatted item label. If there is no selected item or the selected item is not visible, returns an empty string.
properties.meshRotation: The mesh rotation that is applied to all items of the series. The rotation should be a normalized quaternion. For those series types that support item specific rotation, the rotations are multiplied together. Bar3DSeries ignores any rotation that is not around the y-axis. Surface3DSeries applies the rotation only to the selection pointer. Defaults to no rotation.
properties.baseColor: The base color of the series.
properties.itemLabelFormat: The label format for data items in this series. This format is used for single item labels, for example, when an item is selected. How the format is interpreted depends on series type.

QmlSensors.description: The QmlSensors singleton provides the module API.

Repeater.description: Instantiates a number of Item-based components using a provided model.

properties.count: This property holds the number of items in the model.
properties.delegate: The delegate provides a template defining each item instantiated by the repeater.
properties.model: The model providing data for the repeater.
properties.delegateModelAccess: This property determines how delegates can access the model.

SplitView.description: Lays out items with a draggable splitter between each item.

properties.SplitView.fillWidth: This attached property controls whether the item takes the remaining space in the split view after all other items have been laid out.
properties.SplitView.minimumWidth: This attached property controls the minimum width of the split item. The preferredWidth is bound within the minimumWidth and maximumWidth. A split item cannot be dragged to be smaller than its minimumWidth.
properties.SplitView.minimumHeight: This attached property controls the minimum height of the split item. The preferredHeight is bound within the minimumHeight and maximumHeight. A split item cannot be dragged to be smaller than its minimumHeight.
properties.resizing: This property is true when the user is resizing split items by dragging on the splitter handles.
properties.orientation: This property holds the orientation of the SplitView.
properties.SplitView.view: This attached property holds the split view of the item it is attached to, or null if the item is not in a split view.
properties.SplitView.fillHeight: This attached property controls whether the item takes the remaining space in the split view after all other items have been laid out.
properties.SplitView.maximumWidth: This attached property controls the maximum width of the split item. The preferredWidth is bound within the minimumWidth and maximumWidth. A split item cannot be dragged to be larger than its maximumWidth.
properties.SplitView.preferredHeight: This attached property controls the preferred height of the split item. The preferred height will be used as the size of the item, and will be bound within the minimumHeight and maximumHeight. If the preferred height is not set, the item's implicitHeight will be used.
properties.SplitView.preferredWidth: This attached property controls the preferred width of the split item. The preferred width will be used as the size of the item, and will be bound within the minimumWidth and maximumWidth. If the preferred width is not set, the item's implicitWidth will be used.
properties.handle: This property holds the handle component.
properties.SplitView.maximumHeight: This attached property controls the maximum height of the split item. The preferredHeight is bound within the minimumHeight and maximumHeight. A split item cannot be dragged to be larger than its maximumHeight.

Abstract3DSeries.description: A base type for all data series.

properties.visible: Sets the visibility of the series. If false, the series is not rendered.
properties.baseColor: Sets the base color of the series.
properties.baseGradient: Sets the base gradient of the series.
properties.itemLabelVisible: If true, item labels are drawn as floating labels in the graph. Otherwise, item labels are not drawn. To show the item label in an external control, this property is set to false. Defaults to true.
properties.type: The type of the series. One of the QAbstract3DSeries::SeriesType values.
properties.name: The series name. It can be used in item label format with the tag @seriesName.
properties.singleHighlightColor: Sets the single item highlight color of the series.
properties.multiHighlightColor: Sets the multiple item highlight color of the series.
properties.meshSmooth: If true, smooth versions of predefined meshes set via the mesh property are used. This property does not affect custom meshes used when the mesh is set to Abstract3DSeries.MeshUserDefined. Defaults to false.
properties.multiHighlightGradient: Sets the multiple item highlight gradient of the series.
properties.singleHighlightGradient: Sets the single item highlight gradient of the series.
properties.itemLabelFormat: The label format for data items in this series. This format is used for single item labels, for example, when an item is selected. How the format is interpreted depends on series type: Bar3DSeries, Scatter3DSeries, Surface3DSeries.
properties.itemLabel: The formatted item label. If there is no selected item or the selected item is not visible, returns an empty string.
properties.meshRotation: Sets the mesh rotation that is applied to all items of the series. The rotation should be a normalized quaternion. For those series types that support item specific rotation, the rotations are multiplied together. Bar3DSeries ignores any rotation that is not around the y-axis. Surface3DSeries applies the rotation only to the selection pointer. Defaults to no rotation.
properties.mesh: Sets the mesh of the items in the series, or the selection pointer in case of Surface3DSeries. If the mesh is Abstract3DSeries.MeshUserDefined, then the userDefinedMesh property must also be set for items to render properly. The default value depends on the graph type.
properties.colorStyle: Sets the color style for the series.
properties.userDefinedMesh: Sets the filename for a user defined custom mesh for objects that is used when mesh is Abstract3DSeries.MeshUserDefined.

properties.rendererType: This property determines which path rendering backend is active.
properties.vendorExtensionsEnabled: This property controls the usage of non-standard OpenGL extensions.
properties.containsMode: This property determines the definition of contains() for the Shape. It is useful in case you add Qt Quick Input Handlers and you want to react only when the mouse or touchpoint is fully inside the Shape.
properties.preferredRendererType: Requests a specific backend to use for rendering the shape. The possible values are the same as for rendererType. The default is Shape.UnknownRenderer, indicating no particular preference.
properties.status: This property determines the status of the Shape and is relevant when Shape.asynchronous is set to true.
properties.boundingRect: Contains the united bounding rect of all sub paths in the shape.
properties.data: This property holds the ShapePath objects that define the contents of the Shape. It can also contain any other type of objects, since Shape, like Item, allows adding any visual or non-visual objects as children.
properties.fillMode: Set this property to define what happens when the path has a different size than the item.
properties.asynchronous: When rendererType is Shape.GeometryRenderer or Shape.CurveRenderer, a certain amount of preprocessing of the input path is performed on the CPU during the polishing phase of the Shape. This is potentially expensive. To offload this work to separate worker threads, set this property to true.

MonthGrid.description: A grid of days for a calendar month.

properties.delegate: This property holds the item delegate that visualizes each day.
properties.month: This property holds the number of the month. The default value is the current month.
properties.title: This property holds a title for the calendar.
properties.year: This property holds the number of the year.

point QML Value Type.description: a value with x and y attributes.

font QML Value Type.description: a font value with the properties of QFont.  The font type refers to a font value with the properties of QFont.

properties.hintingPreference: The preferred hinting on the text.
properties.kerning: Enables or disables the kerning OpenType feature when shaping the text. Disabling this may improve performance when creating or changing the text, at the expense of some cosmetic features. The default value is true.
properties.preferShaping: Sometimes, a font will apply complex rules to a set of characters in order to display them correctly. In some writing systems, such as Brahmic scripts, this is required in order for the text to be legible, but in for example Latin script, it is merely a cosmetic feature. Setting the preferShaping property to false will disable all such features when they are not required, which will improve performance in most cases.
properties.features: Applies integer values to specific OpenType features when shaping the text based on the contents. This provides advanced access to the font shaping process, and can be used to support font features that are otherwise not covered in the API.
properties.weight: The requested weight of the font. The weight requested must be an integer between 1 and 1000, or one of the predefined values:
properties.bold: Whether the font weight is bold.
properties.family: The family name of the font.
properties.wordSpacing: The word spacing for the font.
properties.styleName: The style name of the font.
properties.strikeout: Whether the font has a strikeout style.
properties.variableAxes: Applies floating point values to variable axes in variable fonts.
properties.contextFontMerging: If the selected font does not contain a certain character, Qt automatically chooses a similar-looking fallback font that contains the character. By default this is done on a character-by-character basis.
properties.italic: Whether the font has an italic style.
properties.letterSpacing: The letter spacing for the font.
properties.pointSize: The font size in points. The point size must be greater than zero.
properties.preferTypoLineMetrics: competing sets of the vertical line metrics that provide the ascent, descent and leading of the font. These are often referred to as the win (Windows) metrics and the typo (typographical) metrics. While the specification recommends using the typo metrics for line spacing, many applications prefer the win metrics unless the USE_TYPO_METRICS flag is set in the fsSelection field of the font. For backwards-compatibility reasons, this is also the case for Qt applications. This is not an issue for fonts that set the USE_TYPO_METRICS flag to indicate that the typo metrics are valid, nor for fonts where the win metrics and typo metrics match up. However, for certain fonts the win metrics may be larger than the preferable line spacing and the USE_TYPO_METRICS flag may be unset by mistake. For such fonts, setting font.preferTypoLineMetrics may give superior results.

ListModel.description: Defines a free-form list data source.

properties.dynamicRoles: By default, the type of a role is fixed the first time the role is used. For example, if you create a role called "data" and assign a number to it, you can no longer assign a string to the "data" role. However, when the dynamicRoles property is enabled, the type of a given role is not fixed and can be different between elements.
properties.count: The number of data entries in the model.

CustomControl.description: Defines styling for a custom (non-built-in) control.

properties.controlType: A unique integer identifying this custom control type. Set the same value on the StyleReader.controlType in your custom control implementation to connect it to this style definition.

XdgOutputManagerV1.description: Provides an extension for describing outputs in a desktop oriented fashion.

AddDefine.description: Adds a preprocessor define to the shader compilation for a pass.

properties.name: The name of the preprocessor macro to define. This becomes the identifier used in #ifdef or #if checks in the shader code.
properties.value: The integer value assigned to the preprocessor macro. Defaults to 1. When non-zero, #if NAME evaluates to true in the shader.

WaylandHardwareLayer.description: Makes a parent WaylandQuickItem use hardware layers for rendering.

properties.stackingLevel: This property holds the stacking level of this hardware layer relative to other hardware layers, and can be used to sort hardware layers. I.e. a layer with a higher level is rendered on top of one with a lower level.

MaskedBlur.description: Applies a blur effect with a varying intesity.

properties.radius: This property defines the distance of the neighboring pixels which affect the blurring of an individual pixel. A larger radius increases the blur effect.
properties.maskSource: This property defines the item that is controlling the final intensity of the blur. The pixel alpha channel value from maskSource defines the actual blur radius that is going to be used for blurring the corresponding source pixel.
properties.cached: This property allows the effect output pixels to be cached in order to improve the rendering performance. Every time the source or effect properties are changed, the pixels in the cache must be updated. Memory consumption is increased, because an extra buffer of memory is required for storing the effect output.
properties.source: This property defines the source item that is going to be blurred.
properties.samples: This property defines how many samples are taken per pixel when blur calculation is done. Larger value produces better quality, but is slower to render.

MapCircle.description: The MapCircle type displays a geographic circle on a Map.

properties.center: This property holds the central point about which the circle is defined.
properties.opacity: This property holds the opacity of the item. Opacity is specified as a number between 0 (fully transparent) and 1 (fully opaque). The default is 1.
properties.radius: This property holds the radius of the circle, in meters on the ground.
properties.autoFadeIn: This property holds whether the item automatically fades in when zooming into the map starting from very low zoom levels. By default this is true. Setting this property to false causes the map item to always have the opacity specified with the QtQuick::Item::opacity property, which is 1.0 by default.
properties.referenceSurface: This property determines the reference surface of the circle. If it is set to QLocation::ReferenceSurface::Map the circle is drawn as a circe on the map with radius approximated to match the map scale at the center of the circle. If it is set to QLocation::ReferenceSurface::Globe the circle is mapped onto a sphere and the great circle path is used to determine the coverage of the circle. Default value is QLocation::ReferenceSurface::Map.
properties.color: This property holds the fill color of the circle when drawn. For no fill, use a transparent color.

ColorAttachment.description: Defines a color attachment for a render pass.

properties.name: The name used to identify this color attachment within the render pass. When materialMode is set to AugmentMaterial, this name is exposed as a fragment shader output variable, allowing custom shader code to write to this attachment.
properties.target: The RenderPassTexture that will be used as the color attachment. The texture must have a color-compatible format (e.g. RGBA8, RGBA16F).

SphereGeometry.description: SphereGeometry allows creation of a sphere in 3D space.

properties.radius: Holds the radius of the sphere.
properties.texCoordAttribute: Holds the geometry texture coordinate attribute.
properties.slices: Holds the number of slices in the sphere.
properties.rings: Holds the number of rings in the sphere.
properties.generateTangents: Holds the value of the automatic tangent vectors generation flag. Tangent vectors are orthogonal to normal vectors.

ValueNode.description: Represents a value node from a server.

properties.serverTimestamp: Server timestamp of the value attribute.
properties.valueType: Type type of this node. The initial value will be QtOpcUa.Constants.Undefined and be fetched from the server when the first connection is established. Any value will be written to the server as the specified type.
properties.sourceTimestamp: Source timestamp of the value attribute.
properties.value: Value of this node. Reading and writing this property will access the node on the server.

MapItemView.description: The MapItemView is used to populate Map from a model.

properties.remove: This property holds the transition that is applied to the map items created by the view when they are removed.
properties.delegateModelAccess: This property determines how delegates can access the model.
properties.model: This property holds the model that provides data used for creating the map items defined by the delegate. Only QAbstractItemModel based models are supported.
properties.add: This property holds the transition that is applied to the map items created by the view when they are instantiated and added to the map.
properties.autoFitViewport: This property controls whether to automatically pan and zoom the viewport to display all map items when items are added or removed.
properties.delegate: This property holds the delegate which defines how each item in the model should be displayed. The Component must contain exactly one MapItem -derived object as the root object.

properties.colorBuffer: Specifies a specific color buffer to clear. If set to NULL (default), and ColorBuffer flag is set, all color buffers will be cleared.
properties.clearStencilValue: Specifies the stencil value to be used.
properties.clearDepthValue: Specifies the clear depth value to be used.
properties.buffers: Specifies the buffer type to be used.
properties.clearColor: Specifies the clear color to be used.

RowLayout.description: Identical to GridLayout, but having only one row.

properties.spacing: This property holds the spacing between each cell. The default value is 5.
properties.uniformCellSizes: If this property is set to true, the layout will force all cells to have a uniform size.
properties.layoutDirection: This property holds the layout direction of the row layout - it controls whether items are laid out from left to right or right to left. If Qt.RightToLeft is specified, left-aligned items will be right-aligned and right-aligned items will be left-aligned.

properties.value: The value of the argument.

Axis.description: QML frontend for the Qt3DInput::QAxis C++ class.

properties.value: Holds the value accumulated from the sourceAxis.
properties.velocity: Returns the velocity. If the sourceAxisType is set to Velocity this is simply the value of the source axis multiplied by the scale. If the sourceAxisType is set to Acceleration, the velocity is integrated using the source axis' value as an acceleration.
properties.buttons: The Buttons that can trigger this Action
properties.inputs: the list of AbstractAxisInput that can trigger this Axis.
properties.scale: The amount to scale the axis value by when accumulating. This can be thought of as the maximum velocity or acceleration the axis can control.

Obsolete Members for InputContext.description: The following members of QML type InputContext are deprecated. They are provided to keep old source code working. We strongly advise against using them in new code.

properties.capsLock: This property is deprecated. We strongly advise against using it in new code.
properties.inputItem: This property is deprecated. We strongly advise against using it in new code.
properties.shift: This property is deprecated. We strongly advise against using it in new code.

PinchEvent.description: For specifying information about a pinch event.

properties.pointCount: Holds the number of points currently touched. The PinchArea will not react until two touch points have initited a gesture, but will remain active until all touch points have been released.
properties.accepted: Setting this property to false in the PinchArea::onPinchStarted handler will result in no further pinch events being generated, and the gesture ignored.

Texture3D.description: An AbstractTexture with a Target3D target format.

properties.options: This property holds the various options that affect the look and feel of the dialog.
properties.currentColor: This property holds the currently selected color in the dialog.
properties.color: This property holds the final accepted color.

MapQuickItem.description: The MapQuickItem type displays an arbitrary Qt Quick object on a Map.

properties.sourceItem: This property holds the source item that will be drawn on the map.
properties.anchorPoint: This property determines which point on the sourceItem that will be lined up with the coordinate on the map.
properties.zoomLevel: This property controls the scaling behaviour of the contents of the MapQuickItem. In particular, by setting this property it is possible to choose between objects that are drawn on the screen (and sized in screen pixels), and those drawn on the map surface (which change size with the zoom level of the map).
properties.coordinate: This property holds the anchor coordinate of the MapQuickItem. The point on the sourceItem that is specified by anchorPoint is kept aligned with this coordinate when drawn on the map.
properties.autoFadeIn: This property holds whether the item automatically fades in when zooming into the map starting from very low zoom levels. By default this is true. Setting this property to false causes the map item to always have the opacity specified with the QtQuick::Item::opacity property, which is 1.0 by default.

BlendEquation.description: The BlendEquation class specifies the equation used for both the RGB blend equation and the Alpha blend equation.

properties.blendFunction: Holds the blend function, which determines how source and destination colors are combined.

FunctionFilter.description: Filters data in a SortFilterProxyModel based on the evaluation of the designated 'filter' method.

XmlListModelRole.description: For specifying a role to an XmlListModel.

properties.name: The name for the role. This name is used to access the model data for this role.
properties.elementName: The name of the XML element, or a path to the XML element, that will be used to read the data. The element must actually contain text.
properties.attributeName: The attribute of the XML element that will be used to read the data. The XML element is specified by elementName property.

HoverHandler.description: Handler for mouse and tablet hover.

properties.parent: The Item which is the scope of the handler; the Item in which it was declared. The handler will handle events on behalf of this Item, which means a pointer event is relevant if at least one of its eventPoints occurs within the Item's interior. Initially target() is the same, but it can be reassigned.
properties.target: The Item which this handler will manipulate.
properties.active: This holds true whenever this Input Handler has taken sole responsibility for handing one or more eventPoints, by successfully taking an exclusive grab of those points. This means that it is keeping its properties up-to-date according to the movements of those eventPoints and actively manipulating its target (if any).
properties.grabPermissions: This property specifies the permissions when this handler's logic decides to take over the exclusive grab, or when it is asked to approve grab takeover or cancellation by another handler.
properties.blocking: Whether this handler prevents other items or handlers behind it from being hovered at the same time. This property is false by default.
properties.acceptedPointerTypes: The types of pointing instruments (generic, stylus, eraser, and so on) that can activate the pointer handler.
properties.acceptedDevices: The types of pointing devices that can activate the pointer handler.
properties.hovered: Holds true whenever any pointing device cursor (mouse or tablet) is within the bounds of the parent Item, extended by the margin, if any.
properties.margin: The margin beyond the bounds of the parent item within which an eventPoint can activate this handler. For example, on a PinchHandler where the target is also the parent, it's useful to set this to a distance at least half the width of a typical user's finger, so that if the parent has been scaled down to a very small size, the pinch gesture is still possible. Or, if a TapHandler-based button is placed near the screen edge, it can be used to comply with Fitts's Law: react to mouse clicks at the screen edge even though the button is visually spaced away from the edge by a few pixels.
properties.cursorShape: This property holds the cursor shape that will appear whenever hovered is true and no other handler is overriding it.
properties.acceptedModifiers: If this property is set, a hover event is handled only if the given keyboard modifiers are pressed. The event is ignored without the modifiers.
properties.point: The eventPoint currently being handled. When no point is currently being handled, this object is reset to default values (all coordinates are 0).

TimelineAnimation.description: A number animation attached to a timeline.

ZoomBlur.description: Applies directional blur effect towards source items center point.

properties.cached: This property allows the effect output pixels to be cached in order to improve the rendering performance.
properties.horizontalOffset: These properties define an offset in pixels for the blur direction center point.
properties.source: This property defines the source item that is going to be blurred.
properties.length: This property defines the maximum perceived amount of movement for each pixel. The amount is smaller near the center and reaches the specified value at the edges.
properties.samples: This property defines how many samples are taken per pixel when blur calculation is done. Larger value produces better quality, but is slower to render.
properties.transparentBorder: This property defines the blur behavior near the edges of the item, where the pixel blurring is affected by the pixels outside the source edges.
properties.verticalOffset: These properties define an offset in pixels for the blur direction center point.

properties.layer: Holds the layer of the texture image.
properties.mipLevel: Holds the mipmap level of the texture image.
properties.mirrored: This property specifies whether the image should be mirrored when loaded. This is a convenience to avoid having to manipulate images to match the origin of the texture coordinates used by the rendering API. By default this property is set to true. This has no effect when using GPU compressed texture formats.
properties.face: Holds the cube map face of the texture image.

CategoryRange.description: Defines a range on a category axis.

properties.endValue: The high end of the category.
properties.label: The label of the category.

Flickable.description: Provides a surface that can be "flicked".

properties.verticalOvershoot: This property holds the vertical overshoot, that is, the vertical distance by which the contents has been dragged or flicked past the bounds of the flickable. The value is negative when the content is dragged or flicked beyond the beginning, and positive when beyond the end; 0.0 otherwise.
properties.contentItem: The internal item that contains the Items to be moved in the Flickable.
properties.interactive: This property describes whether the user can interact with the Flickable. A user cannot drag or flick a Flickable that is not interactive.
properties.rebound: This holds the transition to be applied to the content view when it snaps back to the bounds of the flickable. The transition is triggered when the view is flicked or dragged past the edge of the content area, or when returnToBounds() is called.
properties.pixelAligned: This property sets the alignment of contentX and contentY to pixels (true) or subpixels (false).
properties.horizontalOvershoot: This property holds the horizontal overshoot, that is, the horizontal distance by which the contents has been dragged or flicked past the bounds of the flickable. The value is negative when the content is dragged or flicked beyond the beginning, and positive when beyond the end; 0.0 otherwise.
properties.flickableDirection: This property determines which directions the view can be flicked.
properties.boundsBehavior: This property holds whether the surface may be dragged beyond the Flickable's boundaries, or overshoot the Flickable's boundaries when flicked.
properties.maximumFlickVelocity: This property holds the maximum velocity that the user can flick the view in pixels/second.
properties.pressDelay: This property holds the time to delay (ms) delivering a press to children of the Flickable. This can be useful where reacting to a press before a flicking action has undesirable effects.
properties.synchronousDrag: If this property is set to true, then when the mouse or touchpoint moves far enough to begin dragging the content, the content will jump, such that the content pixel which was under the cursor or touchpoint when pressed remains under that point.
properties.flickDeceleration: This property holds the rate at which a flick will decelerate: the higher the number, the faster it slows down when the user stops flicking via touch. For example 0.0001 is nearly "frictionless", and 10000 feels quite "sticky".
properties.boundsMovement: This property holds whether the flickable will give a feeling that the edges of the view are soft, rather than a hard physical boundary.
properties.acceptedButtons: The mouse buttons that can be used to scroll this Flickable by dragging.
